introEn.text: One lesson, on purpose. The class already owns the four operations. This hour confirms the form, adds mixed numbers and a negative sign, and stops. Do not reteach a month of fractions. If the five problems come back clean, start Lesson 1.1 the next day.

introUz.text: Ataylab bitta dars. Sinf to'rt amalni allaqachon biladi. Bu soat yozuvni tasdiqlaydi, aralash kasr va manfiy ishorani qo'shadi va to'xtaydi. Kasrni bir oy qayta o'qitmang. Besh mashq toza qaytsa, ertaga 1.1-darsdan boshlang.

lessons.titleEn: Fraction fluency, mixed numbers, and signs
lessons.titleUz: Kasr malakasi, aralash kasr va ishora
lessons.goalEn: Confirm the four fraction operations and extend them to mixed numbers and negative fractions, because every later SAT topic still uses this arithmetic.
lessons.goalUz: Kasrning to'rt amalini mustahkamlab, aralash kasr va manfiy kasrga o'tkazish. Keyingi har bir SAT mavzusi shu hisobga tayanadi.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can add, subtract, multiply, and divide positive fractions with a common denominator or a reciprocal.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar musbat kasrlarni umumiy maxraj yoki teskari kasr yordamida qo'sha, ayira, ko'paytira va bo'la oladi.

teacherEn.text: Open with 1/2 + 1/3 and no help. Watch who adds the denominators and lands on 2/5. Put 2 1/4 on the board and have the class turn it into ninths-wait, into fourths, before any new rule. Do Example 1 yourself while they copy. Only then show one negative fraction and the sign of a product.

Avval kasrni bir xil ko'rinishga keltiramiz. Aralash kasr — yashiringan yig'indi. Manfiy ishora qo'shishda ham, ko'paytirishda ham o'z qoidasiga ega. SAT javobni ko'pincha qisqartirilgan kasrda kutadi.
Practice 1–3 is classwork. Practice 4 and 5 go home. Tomorrow, start from whichever of those two came back wrong.

teacherUz.text: Darsni yordamsiz 1/2 + 1/3 dan boshlang. Kim maxrajlarni qo'shib 2/5 chiqarayotganini kuzating. Doskaga 2 1/4 yozing va yangi qoidadan oldin uni to'rtdan birlarga aylantirishni so'rang. 1-misolni o'zingiz yeching, ular ko'chirsin. Shundan keyin bitta manfiy kasr va ko'paytmaning ishorasini ko'rsating.

Avval kasrni bir xil ko'rinishga keltiramiz. Aralash kasr — yashiringan yig'indi. Manfiy ishora qo'shishda ham, ko'paytirishda ham o'z qoidasiga ega. SAT javobni ko'pincha qisqartirilgan kasrda kutadi.
1–3-mashqlar sinfda. 4 va 5 uyga. Ertaga o'sha ikkisidan qaytib kelgan xatodan boshlang.

explainEn.text: A fraction is a division written as a pair. a/b means a ÷ b, and b is never zero. The numerator counts how many parts you have. The denominator names the size of each part. This class already runs the four operations. Today we lock the form of those operations and add the two shapes the SAT hides inside later questions: mixed numbers and negative fractions.
a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / bd
a/b − c/d = (ad − bc) / bd
a/b × c/d = (a·c) / (b·d)
a/b ÷ c/d = a/b × d/c

Any common denominator is legal. The least one keeps the numbers smaller, which matters when a later question already has large denominators. Cancel a common factor before you multiply, while the numbers are still small. Division is not a new operation. Dividing by c/d means multiplying by the reciprocal d/c. The reciprocal of 3/5 is 5/3. Zero still has no reciprocal, so you never flip a fraction whose numerator is zero.

A mixed number is a sum in disguise. 2 1/4 means 2 + 1/4, which is 8/4 + 1/4 = 9/4. Convert to an improper fraction before you multiply or divide. For addition you may add the whole numbers and the fraction parts separately and then carry, but conversion fails less often while speed is still being built. A negative fraction carries one minus sign. Park it on the numerator and write −2/5, not a minus on both floors. The sign rules, which the next lesson will earn properly, are only a tool today: two negatives in a product or a quotient give a positive, one negative gives a negative, and adding a negative moves the result down the number line.

The SAT almost never asks a naked drill such as 'add these two fractions' with nothing around them. The same arithmetic sits inside a percent, a ratio, an equation, or an area formula. If this step is slow, a later question feels hard when the idea was easy. Leave answers in lowest terms. 6/8 is not finished; 3/4 is. An improper fraction such as 29/12 is a fine answer. A mixed number is also fine unless the stem asks for something else. On a student-produced response, 29/12 and 2.416 with a bar, or the decimal 2.4166..., are not all equally convenient: give the fraction.
When two fractions share a sign change, rewrite both with a common denominator before you decide which is larger. Crossing numerators alone fails when the denominators carry different signs.
Keep the LCD as a written scaffold until the student no longer needs it. Erase it only after three clean problems in a row.
On the Digital SAT a fraction answer is almost always simplified. Leave an unreduced form only when the stem asks for an equivalent expression, not a value.

explainUz.text: Kasr — bo'linishning juft ko'rinishi. a/b degani a ÷ b, va b hech qachon nol bo'lmaydi. Surat qo'lingizdagi bo'laklarni sanaydi. Maxraj har bir bo'lakning o'lchamini aytadi. Bu sinf to'rt amalni bajara oladi. Bugun o'sha amallarning yozuvini qotirib qo'yamiz va SAT keyinroq savol ichiga yashiradigan ikki ko'rinishni qo'shamiz: aralash kasr va manfiy kasr.
a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / bd
a/b − c/d = (ad − bc) / bd
a/b × c/d = (a·c) / (b·d)
a/b ÷ c/d = a/b × d/c

Har qanday umumiy maxraj joiz. Eng kichigi sonlarni mayda saqlaydi. Bu keyingi savolda maxrajlar allaqachon katta bo'lganda muhim. Ko'paytirishdan oldin, sonlar hali kichik ekan, umumiy ko'paytuvchini qisqartiring. Bo'lish yangi amal emas. c/d ga bo'lish — teskari kasr d/c ga ko'paytirish demak. 3/5 ning teskarisi 5/3. Nolning teskarisi yo'q, shuning uchun surati nol bo'lgan kasrni ag'darmang.

Aralash kasr — niqoblangan yig'indi. 2 1/4 degani 2 + 1/4, ya'ni 8/4 + 1/4 = 9/4. Ko'paytirish va bo'lishdan oldin noto'g'ri kasrga o'ting. Qo'shishda butun qismlarni alohida, kasr qismlarni alohida qo'shib, so'ng eltkizish mumkin, lekin tezlik hali qurilayotganda aylantirish kamroq xato beradi. Manfiy kasrda bitta minus bor. Uni suratga qo'ying va −2/5 deb yozing, ikkala qavatga ham minus qo'ymang. Ishora qoidalari keyingi darsda to'liq o'rin oladi, bugun esa qurol sifatida: ko'paytma yoki bo'linmada ikki minus musbat beradi, bitta minus manfiy beradi, manfiyni qo'shish natijani son o'qida pastga suradi.

SAT deyarli hech qachon 'shu ikki kasrni qo'shing' deb yalang'och so'ramaydi. Xuddi shu hisob foizning, nisbatning, tenglamaning yoki yuza formulasining ichida o'tiradi. Bu qadam sekin bo'lsa, keyingi savol g'oyasi oson bo'lsa ham qiyin tuyuladi. Javobni oxirigacha qisqartiring. 6/8 tugagan emas, 3/4 tugagan. 29/12 kabi noto'g'ri kasr yaxshi javob. Aralash son ham yaxshi, agar savol boshqasini so'ramasa. O'quvchi o'zi yozadigan javobda kasr o'nli kasrdan qulayroq: 29/12 ni bering.
Ikki kasrda ishora o'zgarsa, qaysi kattaroqligini aytishdan oldin ikkalasini umumiy maxrajga keltiring. Maxrajlar turli ishorali bo'lsa, faqat suratlarni solishtirish xato.
Umumiy maxrajni o'quvchi uchta toza misolgacha yozib tursin. Keyin o'chiring.
Raqamli SAT da kasr javob deyarli har doim qisqartiriladi. Qisqartirilmagan shakl faqat ekvivalent ifoda so'ralganda qoladi, qiymat so'ralganda emas.

examples.promptEn: Compute 2 1/4 + 1/6. Give the answer as a simplified improper fraction.
examples.promptUz: 2 1/4 + 1/6 ni hisoblang. Javobni qisqartirilgan noto'g'ri kasrda yozing.
examples.gloss: mixed number — aralash kasr; simplified — qisqartirilgan; improper fraction — noto'g'ri kasr

steps.en: Convert the mixed number first: 2 1/4 = 8/4 + 1/4 = 9/4.
steps.uz: Avval aralash kasrni aylantiring: 2 1/4 = 8/4 + 1/4 = 9/4.

steps.en: The denominators are 4 and 6. Their least common multiple is 12.
steps.uz: Maxrajlar 4 va 6. Eng kichik umumiy karrali 12.

steps.en: 27/12 + 2/12 = 29/12. 29 and 12 share no common factor greater than 1.
steps.uz: 27/12 + 2/12 = 29/12. 29 va 12 ning 1 dan katta umumiy bo'luvchisi yo'q.

examples.promptEn: Three fourths of a number is 18. What is one half of the number?
examples.promptUz: Bir sonning to'rtdan uchi 18 ga teng. Shu sonning yarmi nechaga teng?
examples.gloss: of — ning; a number — bir son; one half — yarmi

steps.en: Translate the first sentence: (3/4) of the number is 18, so (3/4)x = 18.
steps.uz: Birinchi gapni tarjima qiling: sonning 3/4 qismi 18, demak (3/4)x = 18.

steps.en: Dividing by 3/4 means multiplying by 4/3. x = 18 × 4/3 = 24.
steps.uz: 3/4 ga bo'lish — 4/3 ga ko'paytirish. x = 18 × 4/3 = 24.

steps.en: The question asks for half of the number, not the number. (1/2) × 24 = 12.
steps.uz: Savol sonning o'zini emas, yarmini so'raydi. (1/2) × 24 = 12.

steps.en: D is the whole number. C is the given piece, 18. A is 18 × 1/3, a third of the given piece, not half of the number.
steps.uz: D — sonning o'zi. C — berilgan bo'lak, 18. A — 18 × 1/3, berilgan bo'lakning uchdan biri, sonning yarmi emas.

mistakes.en: Adding the denominators: 1/2 + 1/3 is not 2/5. The parts are different sizes. Common denominator first, and 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6.
mistakes.uz: Maxrajlarni qo'shish: 1/2 + 1/3 bu 2/5 emas. Bo'laklar har xil o'lchamda. Avval umumiy maxraj, va 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6.

mistakes.en: Forgetting to flip when dividing. 7/8 ÷ 1/2 is not 7/16. It is 7/8 × 2/1 = 7/4. The second fraction turns over.
mistakes.uz: Bo'lishda ag'darishni unutish. 7/8 ÷ 1/2 bu 7/16 emas. U 7/8 × 2/1 = 7/4. Ikkinchi kasr ag'dariladi.

mistakes.en: Dropping the sign on a mixed number. −2 1/2 means −(2 + 1/2) = −5/2. It is not −2 + 1/2, and it is not −3/2.
mistakes.uz: Aralash kasrning ishorasini tushirib qoldirish. −2 1/2 degani −(2 + 1/2) = −5/2. U −2 + 1/2 emas va −3/2 ham emas.

introEn.text: Ten lessons on the arithmetic the SAT assumes and never reteaches: the number line, the order of operations, decimals, percent, ratio, proportion, exponents, roots, and scientific notation. A student who can compute these cleanly will recognize them later wearing algebra's clothes.
Do not skip a lesson because it looks like school review. The English stem and the decimal point are part of the skill. If the five problems come back clean, move on the next day.

introUz.text: O'n dars, SAT biladi deb hisoblab, qayta o'qitmaydigan hisob: son o'qi, amallar tartibi, o'nli kasr, foiz, nisbat, proporsiya, daraja, ildiz va ilmiy yozuv. Bularni toza hisoblay olgan o'quvchi keyin ularni algebra kiyimida taniydi.
Maktab takrori ko'ringani uchun darsni tashlab ketmang. Inglizcha savol va o'nli nuqta mahoratning qismi. Besh mashq toza qaytsa, ertaga oldinga o'ting.

lessons.titleEn: Integers, the number line, and absolute value
lessons.titleUz: Butun sonlar, son o'qi va modul
lessons.goalEn: Place integers, name an opposite, and read absolute value as distance from zero so later signed work has a picture.
lessons.goalUz: Butun sonlarni joylashtirish, qarama-qarshi sonni aytish va modulni noldan uzoqlik sifatida o'qish. Keyingi ishorali ishlarning rasmi shu.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can compute with positive fractions. Negative fractions appeared once in the bridge lesson.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar musbat kasrlar bilan hisoblay oladi. Manfiy kasr ko'prik darsida bir marta ko'rilgan.

teacherEn.text: Draw a number line from −5 to 5 before any definition. Ask where −3 lives, and which direction is negative. Then cover the absolute-value bars with your hand and ask what changed: the bars ask for a distance, and a distance has no sign.
Modul — noldan qancha uzoqda ekaning. Uzoqlik manfiy bo'lmaydi. Qarama-qarshi son esa ishorani almashtiradi, masofani emas.
Do the distance from −4 to 3 on the figure together. That is the SAT example. Practice 1–3 in class, 4 and 5 at home.

teacherUz.text: Ta'rifdan oldin −5 dan 5 gacha son o'qini chizing. −3 qayerda turishini va manfiy tomon qaysi ekanini so'rang. So'ng modul chiziqlarini qo'lingiz bilan yoping va nima o'zgarganini so'rang: chiziqlar masofani so'raydi, masofaning ishorasi yo'q.
Modul — noldan qancha uzoqda ekaning. Uzoqlik manfiy bo'lmaydi. Qarama-qarshi son esa ishorani almashtiradi, masofani emas.
−4 dan 3 gacha masofani rasmda birga toping. Bu SAT misoli. 1–3 sinfda, 4 va 5 uyda.

explainEn.text: The integers are the whole numbers and their opposites, with zero between them: …, −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, …. On a number line the positives sit to the right of zero and the negatives sit to the left. Moving right means adding a positive. Moving left means adding a negative, which is subtraction.

The opposite of a number is the same distance from zero on the other side. The opposite of −8 is 8. The opposite of 8 is −8. Zero is its own opposite. Taking the opposite flips the sign and leaves the size alone.
|a| = distance from a to 0

Absolute value is that distance, so it is never negative. |−3| = 3 and |3| = 3 and |0| = 0. The bars do not mean 'make it positive by deleting a minus you do not like.' They mean 'how far from zero.' Distance between two numbers is the absolute value of their difference, and the order inside does not matter: |3 − (−4)| and |(−4) − 3| are the same 7.

A fraction still lives on this line. −1/2 is halfway between −1 and 0. The class already added a negative fraction; the new picture is why −4/10 + 3/10 landed at −1/10, closer to zero but still on the left. The SAT uses this in two quiet ways: a distance on a number line, and an expression such as |x − 2| that measures how far x is from 2. If a choice is negative and the question asked for a distance or an absolute value, that choice is finished before you compute.
Absolute value is distance, not 'drop the minus.' |a − b| and |b − a| are the same number; the order inside only changes the sign of the expression before the bars swallow it.
On a number-line stem, mark both points first. The length of the segment is the absolute value; the direction is not.
Ask out loud: distance from what to what? If the student cannot name both endpoints, they are not ready to compute.

explainUz.text: Butun sonlar — natural sonlar, ularning qarama-qarshilari va o'rtadagi nol: …, −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, …. Son o'qida musbatlar nolning o'ngida, manfiylar chapida turadi. O'ngga yurish musbatni qo'shish. Chapga yurish manfiyni qo'shish, ya'ni ayirish.

Qarama-qarshi son — noldan xuddi shu uzoqlikda, lekin narigi tomonda. −8 ning qarama-qarshisi 8. 8 ning qarama-qarshisi −8. Nol o'zining qarama-qarshisi. Qarama-qarshi olish ishorani almashtiradi, o'lchamni emas.
|a| = a dan 0 gacha bo'lgan masofa

Modul o'sha masofa, shuning uchun u manfiy bo'lmaydi. |−3| = 3, |3| = 3 va |0| = 0. Chiziqlar 'yoqmagan minusni o'chir' degani emas. Ular 'noldan qanchalik uzoq' degani. Ikki son orasidagi masofa ular ayirmasining moduli, ichidagi tartib esa muhim emas: |3 − (−4)| va |(−4) − 3| ikkalasi ham 7.

Kasr ham shu o'qda yashaydi. −1/2 soni −1 va 0 ning o'rtasida. Sinf manfiy kasrni qo'shgan; yangi rasm — nima uchun −4/10 + 3/10 javobi −1/10 chiqqanini, nolga yaqinroq, lekin hali chapda. SAT buni ikki tinch joyda ishlatadi: son o'qidagi masofa va |x − 2| kabi ifoda, ya'ni x 2 dan qanchalik uzoq. Agar savol masofa yoki modul so'rasa va variant manfiy bo'lsa, u variant hisobdan oldin yiqiladi.
Modul — masofa, 'minusni tashlash' emas. |a − b| va |b − a| bir xil son; ichidagi tartib faqat chiziqlar yutgunga qadar ifodaning ishorasini o'zgartiradi.
Son o'qi savolida avval ikkala nuqtani belgilang. Kesma uzunligi — modul; yo'nalish emas.
Baland ovozda so'rang: qayerdan qayergacha masofa? O'quvchi ikkala uchini ayta olmasa, hisoblashga hali erta.

examples.promptUz: |-3| + |2| - |-1| ifodaning qiymatini toping.
examples.gloss: evaluate — qiymatini toping; absolute value — modul

steps.en: Each bar is a distance from zero: |−3| = 3, |2| = 2, and |−1| = 1.
steps.uz: Har bir modul noldan uzoqlik: |-3| = 3, |2| = 2 va |-1| = 1.

steps.en: The expression is now ordinary arithmetic: 3 + 2 − 1.
steps.uz: Ifoda endi oddiy hisob: 3 + 2 - 1.

steps.en: 3 + 2 − 1 = 4. The distances were positive before any subtracting happened.
steps.uz: 3 + 2 - 1 = 4. Ayirishdan oldin masofalar musbat edi.

examples.promptEn: On a number line, point A is at −4 and point B is at 3. What is the distance between A and B?
examples.promptUz: Son o'qida A nuqta −4 da, B nuqta 3 da. A va B orasidagi masofa nechaga teng?
examples.gloss: distance — masofa; between — orasida; point — nuqta

steps.en: Distance is the absolute value of the difference: |3 − (−4)|.
steps.uz: Masofa — ayirmaning moduli: |3 - (-4)|.

steps.en: Subtracting a negative is adding: 3 − (−4) = 3 + 4 = 7, and |7| = 7.
steps.uz: Manfiyni ayirish — qo'shish: 3 - (-4) = 3 + 4 = 7, va |7| = 7.

steps.en: A is what you get from 4 − 3 if the signs are ignored. D is the product 4 × 3. C is a distance with a sign, which a distance does not have.
steps.uz: A — ishoralarni tashlab 4 - 3 qilinsa chiqadi. D — 4 × 3 ko'paytma. C — ishorali masofa, masofaning ishorasi bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.en: Reading |−6| as −6. The bars ask for a length. The length is 6. The opposite of −6 is a different question, and that opposite is also 6, but for a different reason.
mistakes.uz: |-6| ni −6 deb o'qish. Chiziqlar uzunlik so'raydi. Uzunlik 6. −6 ning qarama-qarshisi boshqa savol, u ham 6, lekin boshqa sabab bilan.

mistakes.en: Computing a distance as 3 − 4 = −1 when the points are −4 and 3. The subtraction 3 − (−4) needs both signs. A distance is then wrapped in absolute value so it cannot come out negative.
mistakes.uz: Nuqtalar −4 va 3 bo'lganda masofani 3 - 4 = −1 deb hisoblash. 3 - (−4) ayirmasida ikkala ishora ham kerak. Masofa keyin modulga o'raladi, manfiy chiqishi mumkin emas.

mistakes.en: Thinking the opposite of a number and the absolute value are always the same task. |−8| = 8 and the opposite of −8 is 8, so they agree on negatives. On a positive they split: |8| = 8, while the opposite of 8 is −8.
mistakes.uz: Qarama-qarshi son va modulni doim bir xil ish deb o'ylash. |-8| = 8 va −8 ning qarama-qarshisi ham 8, manfiyda ular mos. Musbatda ajraladi: |8| = 8, 8 ning qarama-qarshisi esa −8.

lessons.goalEn: Evaluate a numerical expression in the agreed order so parentheses, powers, multiplication, and addition stop fighting.
lessons.goalUz: Sonli ifodani kelishilgan tartibda hisoblash: qavs, daraja, ko'paytirish va qo'shish bir-biriga xalaqit bermasin.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can run the four operations on fractions and can read a positive whole-number power as repeated multiplication.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar kasrning to'rt amalini bajara oladi va musbat butun darajani qayta-qayta ko'paytirish deb o'qiy oladi.

teacherEn.text: Write 6 + 4 × 2 on the board and take both answers, 20 and 14, without saying which is right. The disagreement is the lesson. Name the order, then compute Example 1 slowly enough that the class can see division and multiplication happen before the subtraction.
Qavs ichi birinchi. So'ng daraja. So'ng ko'paytirish va bo'lish, chapdan o'ngga. Eng oxirida qo'shish va ayirish, yana chapdan o'ngga.
The SAT example is where a student who rushes left to right loses a point they knew. Practice 1 and 2 are a pair: same numbers, different parentheses. Do them side by side.

teacherUz.text: Doskaga 6 + 4 × 2 yozing va ikkala javobni, 20 va 14 ni, qaysi to'g'riligini aytmasdan oling. Nizo — darsning o'zi. Tartibni ayting, so'ng 1-misolni shunday sekin hisoblangki, bo'lish va ko'paytirish ayirishdan oldin ko'rinsin.
Qavs ichi birinchi. So'ng daraja. So'ng ko'paytirish va bo'lish, chapdan o'ngga. Eng oxirida qo'shish va ayirish, yana chapdan o'ngga.
SAT misoli — chapdan o'ngga yugurgan o'quvchi bilgan savolda ochko yo'qotadigan joy. 1 va 2-mashq juft: sonlar bir xil, qavs boshqa. Ularni yonma-yon yeching.

explainEn.text: An expression is a recipe, and the recipe has an order that does not depend on who is holding the pencil. Parentheses and other grouping marks go first. Exponents go next. Multiplication and division go together, left to right. Addition and subtraction go together, left to right, last.
grouping, then powers, then × and ÷ left to right, then + and − left to right

The fraction bar is a grouping mark even when no parentheses are written. In a/b the whole numerator is computed, the whole denominator is computed, and then you divide. That is why the class's fraction work already obeyed this rule without naming it. 12/4 means (12) ÷ (4), not something that waits its turn behind a later addition.

Left to right matters inside a level. 20 − 8 − 2 is (20 − 8) − 2 = 10, not 20 − (8 − 2). Subtraction and division are not free to swap the way addition and multiplication are. A power tower is the exception students should not invent today: we will write parentheses whenever a power could be misread.

On the SAT this shows up as a student-produced value or as four expressions that look close. The wrong choices are almost always a true computation done in the wrong order: adding before multiplying, or squaring only one piece of a product. If two students disagree, do not average their answers. Recompute from the grouping.
Order of operations is a reading skill before it is a computing skill. Circle every grouping symbol, then every exponent, then decide whether multiplication and division run left to right.
A fraction bar is a grouping symbol for the whole numerator and the whole denominator. Do those stacks completely before you divide.
Force one rewrite with parentheses inserted where the student claims the order lives. Wrong parentheses reveal the misconception.

explainUz.text: Ifoda — retsept, va retseptning tartibi qalam kimda ekaniga bog'liq emas. Avval qavs va boshqa guruhlash belgilari. So'ng daraja. So'ng ko'paytirish va bo'lish birga, chapdan o'ngga. Qo'shish va ayirish birga, chapdan o'ngga, eng oxirida.
guruhlash, so'ng daraja, so'ng × va ÷ chapdan o'ngga, so'ng + va − chapdan o'ngga

Kasr chizig'i — qavs yozilmagan bo'lsa ham guruhlash belgisi. a/b da avval butun surat, avval butun maxraj hisoblanadi, so'ng bo'linadi. Sinfning kasr ishi bu qoidaga nomini aytmasdan allaqachon bo'ysungan. 12/4 degani (12) ÷ (4), keyinroq qo'shishning orqasida kutadigan narsa emas.

Bir daraja ichida chapdan o'ng muhim. 20 − 8 − 2 bu (20 − 8) − 2 = 10, 20 − (8 − 2) emas. Ayirish va bo'lishni qo'shish va ko'paytirishdek erkin almashtirib bo'lmaydi. Darajalar minorasi — bugun o'ylab topilmaydigan istisno: daraja noto'g'ri o'qilishi mumkin bo'lsa, qavs yozamiz.

SAT da bu o'quvchi yozadigan qiymat yoki bir-biriga o'xshash to'rt ifoda bo'lib chiqadi. Noto'g'ri variantlar deyarli har doim to'g'ri hisob, lekin noto'g'ri tartibda: ko'paytirishdan oldin qo'shish yoki ko'paytmaning faqat bitta bo'lagini kvadratga oshirish. Ikki o'quvchi kelishmasa, javoblarini o'rtachalamang. Guruhlashdan qayta hisoblang.
Amallar tartibi avval o'qish mahorati, keyin hisob. Har bir guruhlash belgisini aylana qiling, so'ng darajani, keyin ko'paytirish va bo'lish chapdan o'ngga ketishini tekshiring.
Kasr chizig'i — butun surat va butun maxraj uchun guruhlash. Bo'lishdan oldin ikkala ustunni to'liq hisoblang.
O'quvchi tartib bor deb o'ylagan joyga qavs qo'yib qayta yozdiring. Noto'g'ri qavs xato g'oyani ochadi.

examples.promptEn: Evaluate 8 + 12/4 − 2 × 3.
examples.promptUz: 8 + 12/4 - 2 × 3 ifodaning qiymatini toping.

steps.en: Division and multiplication outrank the addition and the subtraction. Compute 12/4 = 3 and 2 × 3 = 6.
steps.uz: Bo'lish va ko'paytirish qo'shish va ayirishdan oldin turadi. 12/4 = 3 va 2 × 3 = 6 ni hisoblang.

steps.en: The expression has become 8 + 3 − 6. Addition and subtraction now run left to right.
steps.uz: Ifoda 8 + 3 - 6 ga aylandi. Qo'shish va ayirish endi chapdan o'ngga yuradi.

steps.en: 8 + 3 = 11, and 11 − 6 = 5. Doing 8 + 12 first would have been a different problem.
steps.uz: 8 + 3 = 11, va 11 - 6 = 5. Avval 8 + 12 qilish boshqa masala bo'lar edi.

examples.promptEn: What is the value of 2(3 + 5)² − 4² / 2?
examples.promptUz: 2(3 + 5)² - 4² / 2 ifodaning qiymati nechaga teng?

steps.en: Parentheses first: 3 + 5 = 8. The expression is 2(8)² − 4² / 2.
steps.uz: Avval qavs: 3 + 5 = 8. Ifoda 2(8)² - 4² / 2 ga aylanadi.

steps.en: Powers next: 8² = 64 and 4² = 16. Now it reads 2 × 64 − 16 / 2.
steps.uz: So'ng daraja: 8² = 64 va 4² = 16. Endi 2 × 64 - 16 / 2.

steps.en: Multiplication and division left to right: 2 × 64 = 128 and 16 / 2 = 8. Then 128 − 8 = 120.
steps.uz: Ko'paytirish va bo'lish chapdan o'ngga: 2 × 64 = 128 va 16 / 2 = 8. So'ng 128 - 8 = 120.

steps.en: A subtracts 16 instead of 8, skipping the division. C stops at 128. D squares the 2 along with the 8, as in (2 × 8)².
steps.uz: A bo'lishni tashlab 16 ni ayiradi, 8 ni emas. C 128 da to'xtaydi. D 2 ni ham 8 bilan kvadratga oladi, ya'ni (2 × 8)².

mistakes.en: Reading 6 + 4 × 2 from left to right as 10 × 2 = 20. Multiplication is done before the addition, so 6 + 8 = 14. The parentheses in (6 + 4) × 2 are what would make 20.
mistakes.uz: 6 + 4 × 2 ni chapdan o'ngga 10 × 2 = 20 deb o'qish. Ko'paytirish qo'shishdan oldin, shuning uchun 6 + 8 = 14. 20 ni (6 + 4) × 2 dagi qavs qiladi.

mistakes.en: Treating a fraction bar as ordinary left-to-right division of only the first number. In (8 + 4)/2 the bar covers 8 + 4. The value is 6, not 8 + 2.
mistakes.uz: Kasr chizig'ini faqat birinchi songa tegadigan oddiy bo'lish deb olish. (8 + 4)/2 da chiziq 8 + 4 ni qoplaydi. Qiymat 6, 8 + 2 emas.

mistakes.en: Squaring before adding inside parentheses that have not been computed. In (3 + 5)² the sum is 8 and then 64. It is not 3² + 5², and it is not 3 + 25.
mistakes.uz: Hali hisoblanmagan qavs ichida qo'shishdan oldin kvadratga oshirish. (3 + 5)² da yig'indi 8, so'ng 64. Bu 3² + 5² emas va 3 + 25 ham emas.

lessons.goalEn: Move between a fraction and a decimal, and compare them, using a point as the decimal mark the way the test does.
lessons.goalUz: Kasr va o'nli kasr o'rtasida yurish va ularni solishtirish. O'nli belgi imtihondagi kabi nuqta.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can simplify fractions and already know that 1/2 is a half of one whole.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar kasrni qisqartira oladi va 1/2 bitta butunning yarmi ekanini biladi.

teacherEn.text: Write 3,5 and 3.5 on the board as two different things. Ask the class what each means in their school notebook, then what each means on the SAT. Settle it before any conversion: the point is the decimal mark, and the comma in 3,500 is not.
SAT da nuqta o'nli kasrni ajratadi. 3.5 — uch butun besh o'ndan. 3,500 — uch ming besh yuz. Maktabdagi vergulni shu yerga ko'chirmang.
Convert 3/8 by dividing, and have them see 0.375 land exactly. Then do the ordering practice together if the room still calls 0.45 'almost a half' without checking.

teacherUz.text: Doskaga 3,5 va 3.5 ni ikki xil narsa qilib yozing. Sinfdan so'rang: daftarlarida har biri nimani anglatadi, SAT da nimani anglatadi. Aylantirishdan oldin kelishib oling: nuqta o'nli belgi, 3,500 dagi vergul esa emas.
SAT da nuqta o'nli kasrni ajratadi. 3.5 — uch butun besh o'ndan. 3,500 — uch ming besh yuz. Maktabdagi vergulni shu yerga ko'chirmang.
3/8 ni bo'lib aylantiring va 0.375 aynan tushishini ko'rsating. Xona hali 0.45 ni tekshirmasdan 'deyarli yarim' desa, tartiblash mashqini birga qiling.

explainEn.text: A decimal is a fraction whose denominator is a power of 10, written with a point. 0.5 means 5/10, which simplifies to 1/2. 0.25 means 25/100, which simplifies to 1/4. 0.375 means 375/1000, which simplifies to 3/8. The digits after the point are tenths, hundredths, thousandths, and so on.

To turn a fraction into a decimal, divide the numerator by the denominator. 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375, and it stops. 1 ÷ 3 = 0.333… and it does not stop. When a decimal stops, or when a short repeating block is obvious, the SAT is usually happier with the simplified fraction. Give 3/8 unless the question asks for the decimal.

To turn a terminating decimal into a fraction, read the place. 0.2 is two tenths, so 2/10 = 1/5. Then simplify. Comparing a fraction and a decimal is the same job: put both in one form. Halves, fourths, fifths, eighths, and tenths are the conversions worth knowing by sight because they appear inside percents.

The comma is the trap that belongs to this class in particular. On the test, 3.5 is three and five tenths. The number 3,500 is three thousand five hundred. A student who reads 3,500 as 'three and a half' has not missed an algebra idea. They have misread the punctuation. Say the rule every time a large number shows up this month.

Converting a terminating decimal is place-value work: 0.375 is 375/1000, then cancel. A repeating decimal needs the geometric series idea or the 9s / 99s / 999s pattern — only the short patterns appear on the SAT.
When a stem mixes a decimal and a fraction, convert both to the same form before you add. Mixing forms mid-step is how signs and place values drift.
Have the student say the place name out loud: tenths, hundredths, thousandths. Naming the place prevents 0.4 → 4/100.

explainUz.text: O'nli kasr — maxraji 10 ning darajasi bo'lgan kasr, nuqta bilan yoziladi. 0.5 degani 5/10, qisqartirilsa 1/2. 0.25 degani 25/100, qisqartirilsa 1/4. 0.375 degani 375/1000, qisqartirilsa 3/8. Nuqtadan keyingi raqamlar o'ndan, yuzdan, mingdan va shu tartibda.

Kasrni o'nli kasrga aylantirish uchun suratni maxrajga bo'ling. 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375, va u to'xtaydi. 1 ÷ 3 = 0.333… va u to'xtamaydi. O'nli kasr to'xtasa yoki qisqa davr ko'rinib tursa, SAT odatda qisqartirilgan kasrni afzal ko'radi. Savol o'nli kasr so'ramasa, 3/8 ni bering.

Tugaydigan o'nli kasrni kasrga aylantirish uchun o'rinni o'qing. 0.2 — ikki o'ndan, demak 2/10 = 1/5. So'ng qisqartiring. Kasr va o'nli kasrni solishtirish — bir xil ish: ikkalasini bir ko'rinishga keltiring. Yarim, chorak, beshdan bir, sakkizdan bir va o'ndan birni ko'z bilan bilishga arziydi, chunki ular foiz ichida chiqadi.

Vergul — aynan shu sinfga tegadigan tuzoq. Imtihonda 3.5 — uch butun besh o'ndan. 3,500 soni — uch ming besh yuz. 3,500 ni 'uch yarim' deb o'qigan o'quvchi algebra g'oyasini qo'ldan chiqarmagan. U tinish belgisini noto'g'ri o'qigan. Shu oy katta son chiqqan sayin qoidani ayting.
Tugaydigan o'nli kasrni aylantirish — xona qiymati: 0.375 bu 375/1000, so'ng qisqartirish. Takrorlanuvchi o'nli kasr uchun 9 / 99 / 999 qoidasi yetadi — SAT da uzun qatorlar chiqmaydi.
Savolda o'nli kasr va oddiy kasr aralashsa, qo'shishdan oldin ikkalasini bir xil shaklga keltiring. O'rtada aralashtirish ishora va xona qiymatini yo'qotadi.
O'quvchi xona nomini baland aytisin: o'nlik, yuzlik, minglik. Nomlash 0.4 → 4/100 xatosini to'sadi.

examples.promptEn: Compute 3/4 + 1/5 and give a simplified fraction.
examples.promptUz: 3/4 + 1/5 ni hisoblang va qisqartirilgan kasr yozing.

steps.en: The denominators 4 and 5 share no common factor, so the common denominator is 20.
steps.uz: 4 va 5 maxrajlarning umumiy bo'luvchisi yo'q, demak umumiy maxraj 20.

steps.en: 15/20 + 4/20 = 19/20. As a decimal that is 0.95, and the fraction is the better answer.
steps.uz: 15/20 + 4/20 = 19/20. O'nli ko'rinishi 0.95, javob sifatida kasr yaxshiroq.

examples.promptEn: Which of the following is equal to 3/8?
examples.promptUz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 3/8 ga teng?
examples.gloss: which of the following — quyidagilardan qaysi biri; equal to — ga teng

steps.en: Divide 3 by 8. 8 goes into 30 three times, remainder 6; into 60 seven times, remainder 4; into 40 five times. The decimal is 0.375.
steps.uz: 3 ni 8 ga bo'ling. 8 soni 30 ga uch marta, qoldiq 6; 60 ga yetti marta, qoldiq 4; 40 ga besh marta. O'nli kasr 0.375.

steps.en: Check by the place value: 0.375 = 375/1000. Divide numerator and denominator by 125 to get 3/8.
steps.uz: O'rin qiymati bilan tekshiring: 0.375 = 375/1000. Surat va maxrajni 125 ga bo'lib 3/8 chiqadi.

steps.en: A reads the 3 and the 8 and writes them after a point. C is 3/8 with the last digit dropped. D moves the point the wrong way and is ten times too large.
steps.uz: A 3 va 8 ni o'qib, nuqtadan keyin yozib qo'yadi. C — oxirgi raqami tushib qolgan 3/8. D nuqtani noto'g'ri joyga qo'yadi va o'n baravar katta.

mistakes.en: Reading 3,500 as three and five tenths. On this test the comma is not the decimal mark. 3,500 means 3500, and three and five tenths is written 3.5.
mistakes.uz: 3,500 ni uch butun besh o'ndan deb o'qish. Shu imtihonda vergul o'nli belgi emas. 3,500 degani 3500, uch butun besh o'ndan esa 3.5 deb yoziladi.

mistakes.en: Writing 1/4 as 0.4 because both use a 4. One fourth is 0.25. Four tenths, 0.4, is 2/5. The digit has to sit in the hundredths place.
mistakes.uz: 1/4 ni 0.4 deb yozish, chunki ikkalasida ham 4 bor. Chorak — 0.25. To'rt o'ndan, 0.4, bu 2/5. Raqam yuzdanlar o'rnida turishi kerak.

mistakes.en: Comparing 0.45 and 1/2 by the length of the writing. 0.45 is 45/100, and 1/2 is 50/100. The half is larger. A longer decimal is not a larger number.
mistakes.uz: 0.45 va 1/2 ni yozuv uzunligiga qarab solishtirish. 0.45 bu 45/100, 1/2 esa 50/100. Yarim kattaroq. Uzunroq o'nli kasr kattaroq son degani emas.

lessons.titleEn: Percent as a fraction out of 100
lessons.goalEn: Turn a percent into a fraction or a decimal, find a percent of a number, and say what percent one number is of another.
lessons.goalUz: Foizni kasr yoki o'nli kasrga aylantirish, sonning foizini topish va bir son ikkinchisining necha foizi ekanini aytish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can multiply fractions and can convert a terminating decimal such as 0.25 into a fraction.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar kasrlarni ko'paytira oladi va 0.25 kabi tugaydigan o'nli kasrni kasrga aylantira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Start from a fraction they trust. Write 1/4 and ask for the decimal 0.25, then for the percent. Percent means 'per hundred,' so the move is always 'put it over 100' or 'multiply by 1/100.' Do 15% of 80 as (15/100) × 80 and also as 0.15 × 80, and have them see the same 12.
Foiz — 100 dan bir kasr. 15% degani 15/100. '80 ning 15 foizi' degani 80 ni 15/100 ga ko'paytirish. Of so'zi shu yerda ko'paytirish.
The sale-price example is the one to act out: the 10 dollars off is not the price you pay. Circle the question's last noun before they pick a choice.

teacherUz.text: Ular ishonadigan kasrdan boshlang. 1/4 yozing va o'nli kasr 0.25 ni, so'ng foizni so'rang. Foiz 'yuzdan' degani, shuning uchun yurish doim '100 ga bo'ling' yoki '1/100 ga ko'paytiring.' 80 ning 15 foizini (15/100) × 80 va 0.15 × 80 qilib ko'rsating, ikkalasi ham 12.
Foiz — 100 dan bir kasr. 15% degani 15/100. '80 ning 15 foizi' degani 80 ni 15/100 ga ko'paytirish. Of so'zi shu yerda ko'paytirish.
Chegirma misolini o'ynating: 10 dollar ayirilgan summa — siz to'laydigan narx emas. Variant tanlashdan oldin savolning oxirgi otini aylana qilib belgilang.

explainEn.text: A percent is a fraction with denominator 100. 15% means 15/100, which is 3/20, which is 0.15. 100% means 100/100, one whole. 25% means 25/100 = 1/4. 5% means 5/100 = 1/20. If the class can simplify fractions, it can simplify percents. That is the whole idea.
p% of N = (p/100) × N
A is what percent of B?  (A/B) × 100

The word 'of' in '15% of 80' is a multiplication, the same 'of' that meant multiplication in 'three fourths of a number.' Find the fraction first, then multiply. 15% of 80 = (15/100) × 80 = (3/20) × 80 = 12. Going the other way, 8 is what percent of 32? The fraction of the whole is 8/32 = 1/4, and 1/4 of 100% is 25%.

A discount is a percent removed, not the price left behind. 25% off a $40 shirt removes (1/4) × 40 = 10, so the price you pay is 40 − 10 = 30, which is also 75% of 40. The SAT writes both questions. The last line decides which number is the answer: the part removed, or the part that remains. Students who compute beautifully and then box the other number have not missed the percent. They have missed the noun.

Percents can pass 100. 150% of 20 is (3/2) × 20 = 30, more than the original. 1% of a number is that number divided by 100, which is why 1% of 80 is 0.8 and 15% is fifteen times that, or 12. Keep the fraction in view and the large percent stops looking like a new operation.
Percent is a fraction with denominator 100 wearing a percent sign. Translating 'p percent of n' as (p/100)×n is the whole skill; the rest is arithmetic.
p% of n = (p/100)·n
When the stem gives a percent and asks for a fraction of a fraction, convert the percent first, then multiply. Do not leave the % symbol inside an algebra step.

explainUz.text: Foiz — maxraji 100 bo'lgan kasr. 15% degani 15/100, ya'ni 3/20, ya'ni 0.15. 100% degani 100/100, bitta butun. 25% degani 25/100 = 1/4. 5% degani 5/100 = 1/20. Sinf kasrni qisqartira olsa, foizni ham qisqartira oladi. G'oya shu.
N ning p foizi = (p/100) × N
A soni B ning necha foizi?  (A/B) × 100

'80 ning 15 foizi' dagi of — ko'paytirish, xuddi 'sonning to'rtdan uchi' dagi of kabi. Avval kasrni toping, so'ng ko'paytiring. 80 ning 15% i = (15/100) × 80 = (3/20) × 80 = 12. Teskari yo'nalish: 8 soni 32 ning necha foizi? Butunning kasri 8/32 = 1/4, va 100% ning 1/4 qismi 25%.

Chegirma — olib tashlangan foiz, qolgan narx emas. 40 dollarlik ko'ylakdan 25% olib tashlansa, (1/4) × 40 = 10 ketadi, to'lanadigan narx 40 − 10 = 30, bu 40 ning 75 foizi ham. SAT ikkala savolni ham yozadi. Oxirgi gap qaysi son javob ekanini hal qiladi: olib tashlangan qismmi yoki qolgan qismmi. Chiroyli hisoblab, keyin boshqa sonni ramkaga olgan o'quvchi foizni qo'ldan chiqarmagan. U otni qo'ldan chiqargan.

Foiz 100 dan o'tishi mumkin. 20 ning 150 foizi (3/2) × 20 = 30, asl sondan katta. Sonning 1 foizi — o'sha sonni 100 ga bo'lish. Shuning uchun 80 ning 1 foizi 0.8, 15 foizi esa uning o'n besh baravari, ya'ni 12. Kasrni ko'z oldida tutsangiz, katta foiz yangi amaldek ko'rinmaydi.
Foiz — maxraji 100 bo'lgan kasr, foiz belgisi bilan. 'n ning p foizi' ni (p/100)×n deb o'qish — butun mahorat; qolgani hisob.
n ning p% i = (p/100)·n
Savol foiz bersa va kasrdan kasr so'rasa, avval foizni aylantiring, so'ng ko'paytiring. Algebra qadamida % belgisini qoldirmang.

examples.promptEn: What is 15% of 80?
examples.promptUz: 80 ning 15 foizi nechaga teng?

steps.en: Write the percent as a fraction: 15% = 15/100 = 3/20.
steps.uz: Foizni kasr qilib yozing: 15% = 15/100 = 3/20.

steps.en: 'Of' means multiply: (3/20) × 80.
steps.uz: 'Of' ko'paytirish degani: (3/20) × 80.
80/20 = 4, va 3 × 4 = 12. Demak 80 ning 15 foizi 12.

examples.promptEn: A shirt costs $40. It is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price, in dollars?
examples.promptUz: Ko'ylak 40 dollar turadi. U 25% chegirma bilan sotiladi. Chegirmali narx necha dollar?
examples.gloss: sale — chegirma bilan savdo; off — olib tashlangan; price — narx

steps.en: 25% off means the discount is (1/4) of 40, which is 10. That number is how much is removed, not the price.
steps.uz: 25% chegirma degani chegirma 40 ning 1/4 qismi, ya'ni 10. Bu olib tashlangan summa, narx emas.

steps.en: The sale price is what remains: 40 − 10 = 30. Equivalently, you pay 75%, and (3/4) × 40 = 30.
steps.uz: Chegirmali narx — qolgani: 40 - 10 = 30. Xuddi shunday, siz 75% to'laysiz va (3/4) × 40 = 30.

steps.en: A is the discount. B is the percent written as if it were dollars. D adds the discount to the original price.
steps.uz: A — chegirmaning o'zi. B — foiz, go'yo u dollar. D chegirmani asl narxga qo'shib yuboradi.

mistakes.en: Treating 15% as 15, or as 1/15. Fifteen percent is 15/100. One fifteenth is about 6.7%, a different number. The 100 is part of the meaning.
mistakes.uz: 15% ni 15 yoki 1/15 deb olish. O'n besh foiz — 15/100. O'n beshdan bir taxminan 6.7%, boshqa son. 100 ma'noning o'zi.

mistakes.en: Answering with the discount when the question asked for the sale price. Compute both if you need to, then label them. The boxed number has to be the noun in the last line.
mistakes.uz: Savol chegirmali narxni so'raganda chegirmaning o'zi bilan javob berish. Kerak bo'lsa ikkalasini ham hisoblang, so'ng yorliq qo'ying. Ramkadagi son oxirgi gapdagi ot bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.en: Turning '8 is what percent of 32' into 32/8. The whole is the number after 'of.' The fraction is 8/32, and then you scale that fraction up to a percent.
mistakes.uz: '8 soni 32 ning necha foizi' ni 32/8 qilib olish. Butun — of dan keyingi son. Kasr 8/32, so'ng o'sha kasrni foizga ko'tarasiz.

lessons.goalEn: Compute a percent increase or decrease from the original amount, and run two percent changes in a row without adding the percents.
lessons.goalUz: Foiz o'sishi yoki kamayishini eski miqdordan hisoblash va ikki foiz o'zgarishini foizlarni qo'shmasdan ketma-ket bajarish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can find a percent of a number and can name which amount is the whole.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar sonning foizini topa oladi va qaysi miqdor butun ekanini ayta oladi.

teacherEn.text: Put 50 on the board, then 65. Ask 'what changed?' and wait until someone says 15, not 30%. Then ask '15 out of which number?' The original is the denominator. That sentence is the lesson.
Foiz o'zgarishi — o'zgarishni eski sonning ustiga qo'yish. Yangi son maxraj emas. Ikki marta 20% — bu 40% emas, chunki ikkinchi 20% yangi, boshqa songa tushadi.
Act out 100 growing by 20% and then shrinking by 20%. Leave 96 on the board until someone explains why it did not return to 100.

teacherUz.text: Doskaga 50, so'ng 65 yozing. 'Nima o'zgardi?' deb so'rang va kimdir 30% emas, 15 deguncha kuting. So'ng '15 qaysi sonning ustida?' deb so'rang. Eski son — maxraj. Dars o'sha gap.
Foiz o'zgarishi — o'zgarishni eski sonning ustiga qo'yish. Yangi son maxraj emas. Ikki marta 20% — bu 40% emas, chunki ikkinchi 20% yangi, boshqa songa tushadi.
100 ni 20% ga o'stirib, so'ng 20% ga kamaytirib ko'rsating. 96 ni doskada qoldiring, toki kimdir nima uchun 100 ga qaytmaganini tushuntirgunicha.

explainEn.text: Percent change compares the change with the starting amount, not with the ending amount. If a value goes from 50 to 65, the change is 15 and the original is 50, so the percent increase is 15/50 = 3/10 = 30%. If a value goes from 90 to 72, the change is 18 and the original is 90, so the percent decrease is 18/90 = 1/5 = 20%.
percent change = (new − original) / original

A positive result is an increase. A negative result is a decrease. Many questions ask 'by what percent did it decrease?' and want the positive 20%, not −20. Read the noun. The denominator is the original in a change question. Using the new number as the whole is the standard trap, and it produces a smaller percent that looks tidy.

Two percent changes in a row do not add. A 20% increase multiplies by 1 + 1/5 = 6/5. A 20% decrease multiplies by 1 − 1/5 = 4/5. Doing both, in that order, multiplies by (6/5) × (4/5) = 24/25 = 0.96. A quantity that starts at 100 ends at 96. It lost 4%, not 0%. The second 20% was 20% of a bigger number, so it removed more than the first 20% added.

Percentage points are a different unit. A rate that moves from 10% to 15% has moved 5 percentage points. The percent change of that rate is (15 − 10)/10 = 50%. The SAT writes both phrases. 'Increased by 5 percentage points' and 'increased by 50%' can describe the same move, and they are not interchangeable. If the stem says percentage points, subtract the percents. If it says percent, divide by the original.
Percent change always divides by the original amount, not the new one. Successive percents multiply the growth factors; adding the percents is the trap the test writers love.
new = original × (1 ± r/100)
Write the factor 1.08 or 0.92 before you touch the calculator. The factor is the idea; the decimal is only the clothing.

explainUz.text: Foiz o'zgarishi o'zgarishni boshlang'ich miqdor bilan solishtiradi, oxirgi miqdor bilan emas. Qiymat 50 dan 65 ga o'tsa, o'zgarish 15, eski son 50, demak o'sish foizi 15/50 = 3/10 = 30%. Qiymat 90 dan 72 ga tushsa, o'zgarish 18, eski son 90, demak kamayish foizi 18/90 = 1/5 = 20%.
foiz o'zgarishi = (yangi − eski) / eski

Musbat natija — o'sish. Manfiy natija — kamayish. Ko'p savol 'necha foizga kamaydi?' deb so'raydi va −20 ni emas, musbat 20% ni kutadi. Otni o'qing. O'zgarish savolida maxraj — eski son. Yangi sonni butun qilib olish odatiy tuzoq, u tartibli ko'ringan kichikroq foiz beradi.

Ketma-ket ikki foiz o'zgarishi qo'shilmaydi. 20% o'sish 1 + 1/5 = 6/5 ga ko'paytiradi. 20% kamayish 1 − 1/5 = 4/5 ga ko'paytiradi. Ikkalasi shu tartibda (6/5) × (4/5) = 24/25 = 0.96 ga ko'paytiradi. 100 dan boshlangan miqdor 96 da tugaydi. U 0% emas, 4% yo'qotgan. Ikkinchi 20% kattaroq sonning 20 foizi edi, shuning uchun birinchi 20% qo'shganidan ko'proq olib tashladi.

Foiz punkti — boshqa o'lchov. 10% dan 15% ga o'tgan stavka 5 foiz punktiga siljigan. O'sha stavkaning foiz o'zgarishi (15 − 10)/10 = 50%. SAT ikkala iborani ham yozadi. '5 foiz punktiga oshdi' va '50% ga oshdi' bir xil siljishni tasvirlashi mumkin, va ular almashtirilmaydi. Matn foiz punkti desa, foizlarni ayiring. Foiz desa, eskisiga bo'ling.
Foiz o'zgarishi har doim eski qiymatga bo'linadi, yangisiga emas. Ketma-ket foizlar o'sish koeffitsientlarini ko'paytiradi; foizlarni qo'shish — tuzoq.
yangi = eski × (1 ± r/100)
Kalkulyatorga tegishdan oldin 1.08 yoki 0.92 koeffitsientini yozing. G'oya — koeffitsient; o'nli kasr — faqat kiyim.

examples.promptEn: A number increases from 50 to 65. By what percent did it increase?
examples.promptUz: Son 50 dan 65 ga oshdi. U necha foizga oshdi?
examples.gloss: increase — o'sish; by what percent — necha foizga

steps.en: The change is 65 − 50 = 15. The original, which is the denominator, is 50.
steps.uz: O'zgarish 65 - 50 = 15. Maxraj bo'ladigan eski son 50.

steps.en: The fraction of the original is 15/50 = 3/10.
steps.uz: Eski sonning kasri 15/50 = 3/10.

steps.en: As a percent, (3/10) × 100 = 30. The number increased by 30%.
steps.uz: Foizda (3/10) × 100 = 30. Son 30% ga oshdi.

examples.promptEn: A price increases by 20% and then decreases by 20%. If the starting price is 100, what is the final price?
examples.promptUz: Narx 20% ga oshadi, so'ng 20% ga kamayadi. Boshlang'ich narx 100 bo'lsa, oxirgi narx nechaga teng?
examples.gloss: increases by — ga oshadi; decreases by — ga kamayadi; final — oxirgi

steps.en: A 20% increase multiplies by 6/5. 100 × 6/5 = 120.
steps.uz: 20% o'sish 6/5 ga ko'paytiradi. 100 × 6/5 = 120.

steps.en: A 20% decrease multiplies the new amount by 4/5. 120 × 4/5 = 96.
steps.uz: 20% kamayish yangi miqdorni 4/5 ga ko'paytiradi. 120 × 4/5 = 96.

steps.en: C assumes the two 20% moves cancel. A treats both moves as decreases: 100 × 4/5 × 4/5 = 64. D adds 20 and 20 onto 100.
steps.uz: C ikki 20% bir-birini bekor qiladi deb o'ylaydi. A ikkala siljishni ham kamayish deb oladi: 100 × 4/5 × 4/5 = 64. D 100 ga 20 va 20 ni qo'shadi.

mistakes.en: Putting the new amount in the denominator. A drop from 80 to 60 is 20/80 = 25%, not 20/60. The question 'percent decrease' always divides by where the value started.
mistakes.uz: Yangi miqdorni maxrajga qo'yish. 80 dan 60 ga tushish — 20/80 = 25%, 20/60 emas. 'Kamayish foizi' doim qiymat boshlangan joyga bo'linadi.

mistakes.en: Adding successive percents. A 10% increase followed by a 10% increase is not 20%. It is a factor of (11/10) × (11/10). On 200 that ends at 242, not 240.
mistakes.uz: Ketma-ket foizlarni qo'shish. 10% o'sishdan keyin yana 10% o'sish — 20% emas. Bu (11/10) × (11/10) ko'paytuvchi. 200 da natija 242, 240 emas.

mistakes.en: Calling a move from 10% to 15% a 5% increase. That move is 5 percentage points. The percent change is 5/10 = 50%. The word after the number decides which computation you owe.
mistakes.uz: 10% dan 15% ga o'tishni 5% o'sish deb atash. Bu siljish 5 foiz punkti. Foiz o'zgarishi 5/10 = 50%. Sondan keyingi so'z qaysi hisob kerakligini hal qiladi.

lessons.goalEn: Read a ratio as parts of a whole, and a rate as one quantity per one unit of another, including a price per item and a speed.
lessons.goalUz: Nisbatni butunning bo'laklari deb, tezlikni esa bir miqdorning boshqa miqdorning bitta birligiga to'g'ri kelishi deb o'qish. Bunga bitta narsaning narxi va tezlik kiradi.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can simplify a fraction and can find a fraction of a whole number.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar kasrni qisqartira oladi va butun sonning kasrini topa oladi.

teacherEn.text: Draw 2 red counters and 3 blue counters. Ask what fraction are red, and do not accept '2/3' until someone says the whole is 5 counters. The ratio 2:3 means 2 parts and 3 parts, so red is 2/5 of the whole, not 2/3 of the whole.
Nisbat 2:3 degani ikki ulush va uch ulush. Butun — besh ulush. Qizil — butunning 2/5 qismi, 2/3 emas. 2/3 — qizilning ko'kka nisbati, butunga emas.
Then change the picture to a speed: 150 miles in 2.5 hours. The unit rate is the fraction miles/hours. Practice 1–3 in class.

teacherUz.text: 2 ta qizil va 3 ta ko'k tosh chizing. Qizil qanday kasr ekanini so'rang va kimdir butun 5 ta tosh ekanini aytmaguncha '2/3' ni qabul qilmang. 2:3 nisbat — 2 ulush va 3 ulush, demak qizil butunning 2/5 qismi, butunning 2/3 qismi emas.
Nisbat 2:3 degani ikki ulush va uch ulush. Butun — besh ulush. Qizil — butunning 2/5 qismi, 2/3 emas. 2/3 — qizilning ko'kka nisbati, butunga emas.
So'ng rasmni tezlikka almashtiring: 2.5 soatda 150 mil. Birlik tezlik — mil/soat kasri. 1–3 mashq sinfda.

explainEn.text: A ratio a:b compares two amounts by parts. If boys and girls are in the ratio 2:3, there are 2 boy-parts and 3 girl-parts, which is 5 parts altogether. Boys are 2/5 of the class, not 2/3. The fraction 2/3 compares boys with girls, which is a useful fact and a different question. When the whole is 30 students, the boy count is (2/5) × 30 = 12 and the girl count is (3/5) × 30 = 18.

A rate is a ratio of two different units: miles and hours, dollars and apples, cups and cookies. The unit rate is the amount for one unit of the second quantity. 12 apples for $3 is $3/12 = $1/4 per apple, or 0.25 dollars. 180 kilometers in 3 hours is 60 kilometers per hour. You get the unit rate by dividing, which is the same fraction skill as 3/12 = 1/4.
part = (its ratio number / sum of the ratio numbers) × total
unit rate = amount / number of units

Scaling a recipe is the same fraction. If 2 cups of flour make 12 cookies, one cookie needs 2/12 = 1/6 cup, and 30 cookies need 30 × 1/6 = 5 cups. The SAT hides this in a table or a sentence about a map, a paint mix, or a trip. The trap is using 2/3 as the share of the whole when 2:3 was the comparison of the two groups. Say 'parts, then the whole' before anyone multiplies.
A ratio a:b is the fraction a/b after you confirm the order matches the nouns. Unit rate puts 1 in the denominator of the thing you are pricing or timing.
When units disagree (minutes vs hours, cents vs dollars), convert before you form the ratio. A correct fraction with wrong units is still wrong.
Underline the two nouns in the stem. The left noun is the numerator until the sentence says otherwise.

explainUz.text: a:b nisbat ikki miqdorni ulushlar bilan solishtiradi. O'g'il bolalar va qizlar 2:3 nisbatda bo'lsa, 2 ta o'g'il ulushi va 3 ta qiz ulushi bor, jami 5 ulush. O'g'il bolalar sinfning 2/5 qismi, 2/3 emas. 2/3 kasri o'g'ilni qiz bilan solishtiradi — foydali fakt va boshqa savol. Butun 30 o'quvchi bo'lsa, o'g'illar (2/5) × 30 = 12, qizlar (3/5) × 30 = 18.

Tezlik — turli birlikdagi nisbat: mil va soat, dollar va olma, stakan va pechenye. Birlik qiymat — ikkinchi miqdorning bitta birligiga to'g'ri keladigan miqdor. 12 ta olma 3 dollar — olma boshiga 3/12 = 1/4 dollar, ya'ni 0.25. 3 soatda 180 kilometr — soatiga 60 kilometr. Birlik qiymatni bo'lish bilan olasiz, bu 3/12 = 1/4 dagi o'sha kasr mahorati.
ulush = (o'z nisbat soni / nisbat sonlari yig'indisi) × jami
birlik qiymat = miqdor / birliklar soni

Retseptni kattalashtirish — xuddi shu kasr. 2 stakan un 12 ta pechenye bersa, bittasiga 2/12 = 1/6 stakan kerak, 30 tasiga 30 × 1/6 = 5 stakan. SAT buni jadvalda yoki xarita, bo'yoq aralashmasi, safar haqidagi gapda yashiradi. Tuzoq — 2:3 ikki guruhning solishtirmasi bo'lganda 2/3 ni butunning ulushi deb olish. Ko'paytirishdan oldin 'ulushlar, so'ng butun' deb ayting.
Nisbat a:b — tartib otlarga mosligini tekshirgach a/b kasri. Birlik qiymat — baholayotgan yoki vaqtlayotgan narsaning maxrajida 1 turadi.
Birliklar mos kelmasa (daqiqa–soat, tiyin–so'm), nisbat yasashdan oldin aylantiring. Noto'g'ri birlikdagi to'g'ri kasr ham noto'g'ri.
Savoldagi ikkita otni chizing. Gap boshqacha demaguncha chap ot — surat.

examples.promptEn: The ratio of boys to girls in a class of 30 is 2:3. How many boys are in the class?
examples.promptUz: 30 o'quvchili sinfda o'g'il bolalar va qizlar nisbati 2:3. Sinfda nechta o'g'il bola bor?
examples.gloss: ratio — nisbat; boys — o'g'il bolalar; girls — qizlar

steps.en: The parts are 2 + 3 = 5. Boys are 2 of those 5 parts, so the boy fraction of the class is 2/5.
steps.uz: Ulushlar 2 + 3 = 5. O'g'illar shu 5 ulushning 2 tasi, demak sinfning o'g'il kasri 2/5.

steps.en: The class has 30 students. (2/5) × 30 = 12.
steps.uz: Sinfda 30 o'quvchi. (2/5) × 30 = 12.

steps.en: Girls are the other 3/5, which is 18. 12 + 18 = 30, so the parts use up the whole class.
steps.uz: Qizlar qolgan 3/5, ya'ni 18. 12 + 18 = 30, demak ulushlar butun sinfni egallaydi.

examples.promptEn: A car travels 150 miles in 2.5 hours at a constant speed. What is the speed in miles per hour?
examples.promptUz: Mashina tinimsiz tezlikda 2.5 soatda 150 mil yuradi. Tezlik soatiga necha mil?
examples.gloss: per hour — soatiga; constant speed — o'zgarmas tezlik; travels — yuradi

steps.en: Speed is a unit rate: miles divided by hours. 2.5 hours is 5/2 hours.
steps.uz: Tezlik — birlik qiymat: milni soatga bo'lish. 2.5 soat — 5/2 soat.

steps.en: 150 ÷ (5/2) = 150 × 2/5 = 60. The speed is 60 miles per hour.
steps.uz: 150 ÷ (5/2) = 150 × 2/5 = 60. Tezlik soatiga 60 mil.

steps.en: A comes from dividing by 3 instead of 2.5. C adds the time onto the distance. D multiplies 150 × 2.5 and gets a distance, not a speed.
steps.uz: A 2.5 o'rniga 3 ga bo'lishdan chiqadi. C vaqtni masofaga qo'shadi. D 150 × 2.5 ni ko'paytiradi va tezlik emas, masofa oladi.

mistakes.en: Reading 2:3 as the fraction 2/3 of the whole. Two parts out of three parts is 2/3 of the other group. Two parts out of five parts is 2/5 of the whole. Add the parts before you divide.
mistakes.uz: 2:3 ni butunning 2/3 kasri deb o'qish. Ikki ulush uch ulushning 2/3 qismi — ikkinchi guruhga nisbatan. Ikki ulush besh ulushning 2/5 qismi — butunga nisbatan. Bo'lishdan oldin ulushlarni qo'shing.

mistakes.en: Dividing hours by miles when the question asks for miles per hour. The word 'per' names the unit that goes in the denominator. Miles per hour is miles/hours.
mistakes.uz: Savol soatiga mil so'raganda soatni milga bo'lish. 'Per' so'zi maxrajga tushadigan birlikni aytadi. Soatiga mil — mil/soat.

mistakes.en: Scaling a recipe by adding instead of multiplying. If 12 cookies need 2 cups, 30 cookies do not need 2 + 18 cups. They need (30/12) × 2 cups, which is 5.
mistakes.uz: Retseptni ko'paytirish o'rniga qo'shib kattalashtirish. 12 ta pechenyega 2 stakan kerak bo'lsa, 30 tasiga 2 + 18 stakan kerak emas. (30/12) × 2 stakan kerak, ya'ni 5.

lessons.goalEn: Solve a proportion by cross-multiplying or by scaling, and notice when more workers make the time shorter.
lessons.goalUz: Proporsiyani diagonali bo'yicha ko'paytirish yoki masshtablash bilan yechish va ko'proq ishchi vaqtni qisqartirishini sezish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can solve 'a fraction of a number' and can multiply by a reciprocal.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar 'sonning kasri' ni topa oladi va teskari kasrga ko'paytira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Write 3/4 = x/20 and cover the x. Ask which operation undoes 'divide by 20.' Multiplying both sides by 20 is the whole method. Then show one inverse case with painters so the class does not treat every word problem as direct.
Proporsiya — ikki kasr teng. To'g'ri proporsiyada biri o'ssa, ikkinchisi ham o'sadi. Teskari proporsiyada biri o'ssa, ikkinchisi kamayadi: ko'proq bo'yoqchi, kamroq kun.
Practice 4 is the inverse one. Do it on the board even if the others are quiet work.

teacherUz.text: 3/4 = x/20 yozing va x ni yoping. '20 ga bo'lishni' qaysi amal qaytarishini so'rang. Ikki tomonni 20 ga ko'paytirish — butun usul. So'ng bo'yoqchilar bilan bitta teskari holat ko'rsating, sinf har bir masalani to'g'ri proporsiya deb olmasin.
Proporsiya — ikki kasr teng. To'g'ri proporsiyada biri o'ssa, ikkinchisi ham o'sadi. Teskari proporsiyada biri o'ssa, ikkinchisi kamayadi: ko'proq bo'yoqchi, kamroq kun.
4-mashq teskari. Qolganlari tinch ish bo'lsa ham, uni doskada yeching.

explainEn.text: A proportion says two fractions are equal. 3/4 = x/20 means the same relationship at two sizes. Multiply both sides by 20, which is the reciprocal move the class already owns: x = 20 × 3/4 = 15. Cross-multiplying is the same fact written across the equal sign: 4x = 3 × 20, then x = 60/4 = 15. Use whichever picture the class can say back.

Direct proportion: when one amount doubles, the other doubles. Five notebooks cost $8, so one costs 8/5 of a dollar, and fifteen cost 15 × 8/5 = 24 dollars. The fraction cost/notebooks stays constant.

Inverse proportion: when one amount doubles, the other is cut in half. The product stays constant. Four painters take 10 days, so the job is 4 × 10 = 40 painter-days. Five painters take 40/5 = 8 days. More painters, fewer days. Treating that as direct and computing (5/4) × 10 = 12.5 days sends the time the wrong way.

The SAT rarely says the word 'inverse.' It describes the situation: a job shared by more people, a trip at a higher speed, a fixed area with a longer base. Ask 'if this one grows, does the other grow?' before you write the proportion. If the answer is no, you are looking at a constant product, not a constant ratio.
A proportion is two equal ratios. Cross-multiplying is legal only after both ratios are set with matching noun order. Inverse proportion multiplies to a constant: xy = k.
a/b = c/d  ⇒  ad = bc
On word problems, write the blank as a variable in the same slot both times. Moving the blank mid-proportion flips the answer.
Before cross-multiplying, read the two ratios aloud with their nouns. If the nouns do not line up, rebuild the proportion instead of forcing the arithmetic.

explainUz.text: Proporsiya ikki kasr teng deydi. 3/4 = x/20 degani bir xil munosabat ikki o'lchamda. Ikki tomonni 20 ga ko'paytiring — sinf bu teskari kasr yurishini allaqachon biladi: x = 20 × 3/4 = 15. Diagonali bo'yicha ko'paytirish — tenglikning ikki yonida yozilgan o'sha fakt: 4x = 3 × 20, so'ng x = 60/4 = 15. Sinf qaysi rasmni qaytara olsa, o'shanisini ishlating.

To'g'ri proporsiya: biri ikki baravar bo'lsa, ikkinchisi ham ikki baravar. Besh daftarning narxi 8 dollar, bittasining narxi 8/5 dollar, o'n beshtasining narxi 15 × 8/5 = 24 dollar. Narx/daftar kasri o'zgarmaydi.

Teskari proporsiya: biri ikki baravar bo'lsa, ikkinchisi yarmiga tushadi. Ko'paytma o'zgarmaydi. To'rt bo'yoqchi 10 kun ishlasa, ish 4 × 10 = 40 bo'yoqchi-kun. Besh bo'yoqchi 40/5 = 8 kun ishlaydi. Ko'proq bo'yoqchi, kamroq kun. Buni to'g'ri deb olib (5/4) × 10 = 12.5 kun hisoblash vaqtni teskari tomonga yuboradi.

SAT 'teskari' so'zini kam aytadi. U vaziyatni tasvirlaydi: ko'proq odam bo'lib bo'linadigan ish, tezroq yuriladigan safar, asosi uzunroq bo'lgan o'zgarmas yuza. Proporsiya yozishdan oldin so'rang: 'biri o'ssa, ikkinchisi o'sadimi?' Javob yo'q bo'lsa, siz o'zgarmas nisbatga emas, o'zgarmas ko'paytmaga qarayapsiz.
Proporsiya — ikkita teng nisbat. Chatishtirib ko'paytirish faqat ikkala nisbatda ot tartibi bir xil bo'lgach qonuniy. Teskari proporsiya ko'paytmasi doimiy: xy = k.
a/b = c/d  ⇒  ad = bc
Matnli masalada bo'shliqni har safar bir xil joydagi o'zgaruvchi qilib yozing. Bo'shliqni ko'chirish javobni ag'daradi.
Chatishtirishdan oldin ikkala nisbatni otlari bilan baland o'qing. Otlar mos kelmasa, hisobni majburlamang — proporsiyani qayta quring.

examples.promptEn: Solve the proportion 3/4 = x/20.
examples.promptUz: 3/4 = x/20 proporsiyasini yeching.

steps.en: Multiply both sides by 20: x = 20 × 3/4.
steps.uz: Ikki tomonni 20 ga ko'paytiring: x = 20 × 3/4.

steps.en: Check: 3/4 = 15/20, and 15/20 simplifies to 3/4.
steps.uz: Tekshiruv: 3/4 = 15/20, va 15/20 qisqartirilsa 3/4.

examples.promptEn: Five notebooks cost $8. At the same price per notebook, what is the cost of 15 notebooks?
examples.promptUz: Besh daftar 8 dollar turadi. Daftar boshiga narx o'sha bo'lsa, 15 daftar necha dollar turadi?
examples.gloss: same price — o'sha narx; cost — narx, turadi

steps.en: The price per notebook is 8/5 dollars. Fifteen notebooks cost 15 × 8/5.
steps.uz: Daftar boshiga narx 8/5 dollar. O'n besh daftar 15 × 8/5 turadi.

steps.en: 15/5 = 3, and 3 × 8 = 24. The cost is 24 dollars.
steps.uz: 15/5 = 3, va 3 × 8 = 24. Narx 24 dollar.

steps.en: The scale from 5 notebooks to 15 is 3, so the cost also triples: 8 × 3 = 24. A leaves the cost at 15. B adds 15 to 8. D multiplies 8 × 5.
steps.uz: 5 daftardan 15 gacha masshtab 3, demak narx ham uch baravar: 8 × 3 = 24. A narxni 15 da qoldiradi. B 8 ga 15 ni qo'shadi. D 8 × 5 ni ko'paytiradi.

mistakes.en: Cross-multiplying in the wrong direction and getting 3x = 80 from 3/4 = x/20. The products of opposite corners are 3 × 20 and 4 × x. Then 4x = 60, so x = 15.
mistakes.uz: Diagonali bo'yicha noto'g'ri ko'paytirib, 3/4 = x/20 dan 3x = 80 olish. Qarama-qarshi burchaklar ko'paytmasi 3 × 20 va 4 × x. So'ng 4x = 60, demak x = 15.

mistakes.en: Using a direct proportion for a shared job. If 4 painters need 10 days, 5 painters do not need more days. The painter-days stay at 40, so the time falls to 8 days.
mistakes.uz: Bo'lib bajariladigan ishga to'g'ri proporsiya qo'llash. 4 bo'yoqchiga 10 kun kerak bo'lsa, 5 bo'yoqchiga ko'proq kun kerak emas. Bo'yoqchi-kun 40 da qoladi, vaqt 8 kunga tushadi.

mistakes.en: Forgetting to simplify before scaling and then mishandling a large product. 8/5 × 15 is easier as 8 × 3. Cancel the 5 against the 15 first.
mistakes.uz: Masshtablashdan oldin qisqartirishni unutib, katta ko'paytmani chalkashtirish. 8/5 × 15 ni 8 × 3 qilib olish osonroq. Avval 5 ni 15 bilan qisqartiring.

lessons.goalEn: Multiply and divide powers with the same base, raise a power to a power, and read a zero or negative exponent as a fraction move.
lessons.goalUz: Bir xil asosli darajalarni ko'paytirish va bo'lish, darajani darajaga ko'tarish va nol yoki manfiy darajani kasr yurishi deb o'qish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students know that 2³ means 2 × 2 × 2 and can simplify a fraction such as 1/8.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar 2³ degani 2 × 2 × 2 ekanini biladi va 1/8 kabi kasrni qisqartira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Expand 2³ × 2² as five factors of 2 before you write the rule. The rule is a summary of counting, not a spell. Then show one negative exponent as a reciprocal so it does not look like a sign change.
Darajalarni ko'paytirganda ko'rsatkichlar qo'shiladi, asoslar emas. 2³ × 2² — bu 4³ emas. Manfiy daraja sonni manfiy qilmaydi. U kasrning suratiga tushiradi.
Keep the base the same in every first example. Different bases, such as 2³ × 3², do not combine.

teacherUz.text: Qoidani yozishdan oldin 2³ × 2² ni beshta 2 ko'paytmasi qilib yoying. Qoida — sanashning qisqartmasi, afsun emas. So'ng bitta manfiy darajani teskari kasr qilib ko'rsating, u ishora almashtirishdek ko'rinmasin.
Darajalarni ko'paytirganda ko'rsatkichlar qo'shiladi, asoslar emas. 2³ × 2² — bu 4³ emas. Manfiy daraja sonni manfiy qilmaydi. U kasrning suratiga tushiradi.
Birinchi misollarda asosni bir xil saqlang. 2³ × 3² kabi turli asoslar qo'shilmaydi.

explainEn.text: In aⁿ, the base is a and the exponent is n. aⁿ means n factors of a, when n is a positive integer. The rules below are shortcuts for counting those factors. They require the same base.
a^m × a^n = a^(m+n)
a^m / a^n = a^(m−n)
(a^m)^n = a^(mn)
a^0 = 1, for a ≠ 0,    and    a^(−n) = 1/a^n

So 2³ × 2² = 2⁵ = 32, because you have three factors and then two more. (3²)³ / 3⁴ = 3⁶ / 3⁴ = 3² = 9. A power of a power multiplies the exponents. It does not add them. 4⁰ = 1, not 0. The zero exponent means the factors have all cancelled, and what remains is 1. 2⁻³ = 1/2³ = 1/8. The negative exponent does not make the answer negative. It moves the base to the denominator.

The SAT asks for a single power, or for the value. The traps are adding the bases (2³ × 2² = 4⁵), multiplying the bases, and reading 2⁻³ as −8. If the bases differ, stop. 2³ × 3² = 8 × 9 = 72, and there is no single-base shortcut. Fractions return here: a negative exponent is a reciprocal, which this class already computes.

A useful check is to expand one small case before trusting the shortcut on a large one. 10³ / 10¹ = 1000/10 = 100 = 10², which matches subtracting the exponents. Once that picture is steady, the shortcut is safe.
Exponent rules rearrange multiplication of the same base. They do not move addition: a² + a³ is not a⁵. When bases differ, factor or rewrite before you combine.
aᵐ·aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ ·  (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ ·  a⁰ = 1 (a ≠ 0)
Negative exponents are reciprocals, not negative numbers. a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ. Students who 'bring the minus down' fail every SAT item that uses them.

explainUz.text: aⁿ da asos a, daraja ko'rsatkichi n. n musbat butun bo'lsa, aⁿ degani a ning n ta ko'paytuvchisi. Quyidagi qoidalar o'sha ko'paytuvchilarni sanashning qisqartmasi. Ular bir xil asosni talab qiladi.
a^m × a^n = a^(m+n)
a^m / a^n = a^(m−n)
(a^m)^n = a^(mn)
a^0 = 1, a ≠ 0 bo'lganda,    va    a^(−n) = 1/a^n

Demak 2³ × 2² = 2⁵ = 32, chunki uchta ko'paytuvchi va yana ikkitasi bor. (3²)³ / 3⁴ = 3⁶ / 3⁴ = 3² = 9. Darajaning darajasi ko'rsatkichlarni ko'paytiradi. Qo'shmaydi. 4⁰ = 1, nol emas. Nol daraja degani ko'paytuvchilarning hammasi qisqargan va 1 qolgan. 2⁻³ = 1/2³ = 1/8. Manfiy daraja javobni manfiy qilmaydi. U asosni maxrajga tushiradi.

SAT bitta daraja yoki qiymat so'raydi. Tuzoqlar — asoslarni qo'shish (2³ × 2² = 4⁵), asoslarni ko'paytirish va 2⁻³ ni −8 deb o'qish. Asoslar turlicha bo'lsa, to'xtang. 2³ × 3² = 8 × 9 = 72, va bitta asosli qisqa yo'l yo'q. Kasr shu yerga qaytadi: manfiy daraja — teskari kasr, sinf uni allaqachon hisoblaydi.

Foydali tekshiruv — katta misolda qisqa yo'lga ishonishdan oldin bitta kichik holatni yoyish. 10³ / 10¹ = 1000/10 = 100 = 10², bu ko'rsatkichlarni ayirishga mos. Rasm turg'un bo'lsa, qisqa yo'l xavfsiz.
Daraja qoidalari bir xil asosning ko'paytmasini qayta tartiblaydi. Qo'shishni ko'chirmaydi: a² + a³ bu a⁵ emas. Asoslar turlicha bo'lsa, birlashtirishdan oldin ajrating yoki qayta yozing.
aᵐ·aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ ·  (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ ·  a⁰ = 1 (a ≠ 0)
Manfiy daraja — teskari son, manfiy son emas. a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ. Minusni pastga tushiradigan o'quvchi shu mavzudagi har bir SAT savolida yiqiladi.

examples.promptEn: Evaluate 2³ × 2².

steps.en: The bases match, so add the exponents: 2³ × 2² = 2^(3+2) = 2⁵.
steps.uz: Asoslar bir xil, demak ko'rsatkichlarni qo'shing: 2³ × 2² = 2^(3+2) = 2⁵.

steps.en: 2⁵ means five factors of 2: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2.
steps.uz: 2⁵ degani beshta 2: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2.

steps.en: That product is 32. Adding the bases to get 4⁵ would be a different and wrong move.
steps.uz: Ko'paytma 32. Asoslarni qo'shib 4⁵ olish boshqa va noto'g'ri yurish bo'lar edi.

examples.promptEn: What is the value of (3²)³ / 3⁴?
examples.promptUz: (3²)³ / 3⁴ ifodaning qiymati nechaga teng?

steps.en: A power of a power multiplies the exponents: (3²)³ = 3⁶.
steps.uz: Darajaning darajasi ko'rsatkichlarni ko'paytiradi: (3²)³ = 3⁶.

steps.en: Dividing powers subtracts exponents: 3⁶ / 3⁴ = 3^(6−4) = 3².
steps.uz: Darajalarni bo'lish ko'rsatkichlarni ayiradi: 3⁶ / 3⁴ = 3^(6-4) = 3².

steps.en: 3² = 9. A subtracts 2 − something and lands on 3¹. C is 3³, from adding 2 + something. D is 3⁴, the denominator left behind.
steps.uz: 3² = 9. A 2 ni ayirib 3¹ ga tushadi. C — 3³, qayerdandir qo'shishdan. D — 3⁴, maxrajning o'zi qolib ketgan.

mistakes.en: Adding the bases. 2³ × 2² is 2⁵, not 4⁵ and not 4³. The base stays 2 because every factor in the expansion is a 2.
mistakes.uz: Asoslarni qo'shish. 2³ × 2² bu 2⁵, 4⁵ emas va 4³ ham emas. Asos 2 da qoladi, chunki yoyilmadagi har bir ko'paytuvchi 2.

mistakes.en: Adding exponents in a power of a power. (3²)³ is 3⁶, not 3⁵. You multiply 2 × 3. Adding is the rule for 3² × 3³.
mistakes.uz: Darajaning darajasida ko'rsatkichlarni qo'shish. (3²)³ bu 3⁶, 3⁵ emas. 2 × 3 ni ko'paytirasiz. Qo'shish — 3² × 3³ uchun qoida.

mistakes.en: Reading a negative exponent as a negative number. 2⁻³ = 1/8, which is positive. The minus moves the power downstairs. It does not change the sign of the base.
mistakes.uz: Manfiy darajani manfiy son deb o'qish. 2⁻³ = 1/8, bu musbat. Minus darajani pastga tushiradi. U asosning ishorasini o'zgartirmaydi.

lessons.goalEn: Evaluate a perfect-square root, simplify a radical by pulling out squares, and add radicals only when the radicand matches.
lessons.goalUz: Mukammal kvadratning ildizini hisoblash, kvadratlarni tashqariga chiqarib radikalni soddalashtirish va radikallarni faqat ildiz osti bir xil bo'lganda qo'shish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can list the squares 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100 and can multiply fractions.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100 kvadratlarini sana oladi va kasrlarni ko'paytira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Ask for √49 before you ask for √50. The perfect square is the anchor. Then write √18 = √(9 × 2) and pull the 3 out. Only after that, add √50 and √8, because the class needs to see why √50 + √8 is not √58.
Ildiz ostida ko'paytma bo'lsa, kvadratni tashqariga chiqaramiz. Qo'shish esa boshqa ish: ildiz osti bir xil bo'lsa, oldidagi sonlar qo'shiladi. √50 + √8 bu √58 emas.
Insist on the positive root today. √49 is 7, not −7, when the symbol is written. The equation x² = 49 will bring both answers later.

teacherUz.text: √50 ni so'rashdan oldin √49 ni so'rang. Mukammal kvadrat — tayanch. So'ng √18 = √(9 × 2) yozing va 3 ni tashqariga chiqaring. Shundan keyingina √50 va √8 ni qo'shing, sinf nima uchun √50 + √8 bu √58 emasligini ko'rsin.
Ildiz ostida ko'paytma bo'lsa, kvadratni tashqariga chiqaramiz. Qo'shish esa boshqa ish: ildiz osti bir xil bo'lsa, oldidagi sonlar qo'shiladi. √50 + √8 bu √58 emas.
Bugun musbat ildizda turing. Belgining o'zi yozilsa, √49 bu 7, −7 emas. x² = 49 tenglamasi ikkala javobni keyinroq olib keladi.

explainEn.text: The square root symbol √a means the nonnegative number whose square is a. √49 = 7 because 7² = 49. √(4/9) = 2/3 because (2/3)² = 4/9. A fraction under a root can be rooted on the top and on the bottom when both are perfect squares. Cube roots will appear only as 'what number, three times multiplied, gives this': ∛27 = 3.

If the number under the root has a square factor, pull that square out. √18 = √(9 × 2) = 3√2. √12 = √(4 × 3) = 2√3. √32 = √(16 × 2) = 4√2. The number left under the root should have no perfect-square factor other than 1. That simplified form is what the SAT calls 'simplest radical form.'
√(ab) = √a × √b,    when a and b are nonnegative

You may add radicals only after the part under the root is the same. √50 + √8 = √(25 × 2) + √(4 × 2) = 5√2 + 2√2 = 7√2. This is the same move as 5x + 2x = 7x. The √2 is the common 'like term.' √50 + √8 is not √58, just as 5x + 2y is not 7 of anything.

The symbol itself returns one value, the nonnegative one. Later, the equation x² = 49 has two solutions, 7 and −7, because both square to 49. Do not import those two answers into a plain √49. On multiple choice, a distractor is often the unsimplified root, the sum of the numbers under the roots, or the negative.
A square root asks for the non-negative number whose square is the radicand. √(a²) = |a|, not a, when a might be negative. On the SAT, domain restrictions hide inside radical equations.
Simplifying √(72) = √(36·2) = 6√2 is factoring out perfect squares, not 'dividing by 2 under the root.'
Before simplifying, ask whether the radicand is a perfect square, a product with a perfect square, or neither.

explainUz.text: √a belgisi — kvadrati a ga teng bo'lgan manfiy bo'lmagan son. √49 = 7, chunki 7² = 49. √(4/9) = 2/3, chunki (2/3)² = 4/9. Ildiz ostidagi kasrning surati va maxraji mukammal kvadrat bo'lsa, ildizni yuqorida ham, pastda ham olish mumkin. Kub ildiz faqat 'qaysi sonni uch marta ko'paytirsam shu chiqadi' bo'lib keladi: ∛27 = 3.

Ildiz ostidagi sonda kvadrat ko'paytuvchi bo'lsa, o'sha kvadratni tashqariga chiqaring. √18 = √(9 × 2) = 3√2. √12 = √(4 × 3) = 2√3. √32 = √(16 × 2) = 4√2. Ildiz ostida 1 dan boshqa mukammal kvadrat qolmasin. SAT o'sha sodda ko'rinishni 'simplest radical form' deb ataydi.
√(ab) = √a × √b,    a va b manfiy bo'lmaganda

Radikallarni faqat ildiz osti bir xil bo'lgandan keyin qo'shasiz. √50 + √8 = √(25 × 2) + √(4 × 2) = 5√2 + 2√2 = 7√2. Bu 5x + 2x = 7x dagi yurish. √2 — umumiy o'xshash had. √50 + √8 bu √58 emas, xuddi 5x + 2y hech narsaning 7 tasi bo'lmaganidek.

Belgining o'zi bitta qiymat qaytaradi, manfiy bo'lmaganini. Keyinroq x² = 49 tenglamaning ikki yechimi bor, 7 va −7, chunki ikkalasining kvadrati ham 49. O'sha ikki javobni oddiy √49 ga olib kirmang. Ko'p tanlovda chalg'ituvchi variant ko'pincha soddalashtirilmagan ildiz, ildiz ostidagi sonlarning yig'indisi yoki manfiy son bo'ladi.
Kvadrat ildiz — kvadrati ildiz ostidagi songa teng bo'lgan manfiy bo'lmagan son. a manfiy bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa √(a²) = |a|, a emas. SAT da soha cheklovi ildizli tenglamalarda yashirinadi.
√(72) = √(36·2) = 6√2 — mukammal kvadratlarni ajratish, 'ildiz ostini 2 ga bo'lish' emas.
Soddalashtirishdan oldin so'rang: ildiz osti mukammal kvadratmi, mukammal kvadrat ko'paytuvchilimi, yoki yo'qmi?

steps.en: √49 = 7 because 7² = 49. √16 = 4 because 4² = 16.
Both roots came out as whole numbers, so add those whole numbers: 7 + 4.
steps.uz: Ikkala ildiz ham butun son bo'lib chiqdi, demak o'sha butun sonlarni qo'shing: 7 + 4.

steps.en: The sum is 11. Adding under one root, √(49 + 16) = √65, would be a different expression.
steps.uz: Yig'indi 11. Bitta ildiz ostida qo'shish, √(49 + 16) = √65, boshqa ifoda bo'lar edi.

examples.promptEn: Which expression is equivalent to √50 + √8?
examples.promptUz: Qaysi ifoda √50 + √8 ga teng kuchli?

steps.uz: Kvadratlarni chiqaring: √50 = √(25 × 2) = 5√2 va √8 = √(4 × 2) = 2√2.

steps.en: The radicand is now the same, so add the coefficients: 5√2 + 2√2 = 7√2.
steps.uz: Ildiz osti endi bir xil, demak oldidagi sonlarni qo'shing: 5√2 + 2√2 = 7√2.

steps.en: A adds under the root. C adds the numbers that were under the root before simplifying, 5 + something wrong, or 50 and 8's roots added as 5√2 + 5√2. D multiplies 50 × 8.
steps.uz: A ildiz ostida qo'shadi. C soddalashtirishdan oldingi sonlarni qo'shadi. D 50 × 8 ni ko'paytiradi.

mistakes.en: Adding under the root. √9 + √16 = 3 + 4 = 7. It is not √25. The root symbol does not distribute over addition.
mistakes.uz: Ildiz ostida qo'shish. √9 + √16 = 3 + 4 = 7. Bu √25 emas. Ildiz belgisi qo'shish ustiga tarqalmaydi.

mistakes.en: Leaving a square inside. √12 is not finished while 4 still sits under the root. Pull it out: √12 = 2√3. Check by squaring 2√3: 4 × 3 = 12.
mistakes.uz: Kvadratni ichida qoldirish. Ildiz ostida 4 turganida √12 tugagan emas. Uni chiqaring: √12 = 2√3. 2√3 ni kvadratga oshirib tekshiring: 4 × 3 = 12.

mistakes.en: Giving both 7 and −7 for the symbol √49. The symbol denotes the nonnegative root. Both signs appear when the question is the equation x² = 49.
mistakes.uz: √49 belgisi uchun 7 ni ham, −7 ni ham berish. Belgi manfiy bo'lmagan ildizni bildiradi. Ikkala ishora x² = 49 tenglamasi so'ralganda chiqadi.
