lessons.goalEn: Write a probability as a fraction of favorable outcomes over all equally likely outcomes, including a conditional count.
lessons.goalUz: Ehtimollikni teng ehtimolli barcha holatlar ichidan qulay holatlar kasri deb yozish, shartli sanoqni ham.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can simplify a fraction and can read 'of' as a share of a group.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar kasrni qisqartira oladi va 'of' ni guruhning ulushi deb o'qiy oladi.

teacherEn.text: Empty a bag story onto the board: 3 red, 5 blue, 8 marbles. Ask for the probability of red before any formula. The fraction 3/8 should come from the counters, not from a definition.
Ehtimollik — kasr. Surat qulay holat, maxraj barcha teng ehtimolli holat. 'Emas' so'zi 1 dan ayirish. Sportchilar ichidan musiqa — maxraj endi butun sinf emas, faqat sportchilar.
Do the conditional example slowly. The denominator changes. That is the whole idea.

teacherUz.text: Qop hikoyasini doskaga bo'shating: 3 qizil, 5 ko'k, 8 ta marmar. Formuladan oldin qizil ehtimolini so'rang. 3/8 kasri ta'rifdan emas, toshlardan kelishi kerak.
Ehtimollik — kasr. Surat qulay holat, maxraj barcha teng ehtimolli holat. 'Emas' so'zi 1 dan ayirish. Sportchilar ichidan musiqa — maxraj endi butun sinf emas, faqat sportchilar.
Shartli misolni sekin yeching. Maxraj o'zgaradi. G'oya shu.

explainEn.text: If outcomes are equally likely, the probability of an event is the number of favorable outcomes divided by the number of possible outcomes. A bag with 3 red marbles and 5 blue marbles has 8 marbles. The probability of red is 3/8. The probability of blue is 5/8. They add to 1, because red and blue are the only colors and they do not overlap.

The probability of the opposite, 'not red,' is 1 minus the probability of red. If P(red) = 1/5, then P(not red) = 4/5. You can also count: the outcomes that are not the favorable ones, over the same total. A fair coin has P(heads) = 1/2. A fair six-sided die has P(even) = 3/6 = 1/2, the faces 2, 4, and 6.
P(event) = favorable / total, when outcomes are equally likely

A conditional probability shrinks the total. In a class of 20, 12 play a sport, and 8 of those 12 also play music. If a student is chosen from the students who play a sport, the probability they play music is 8/12 = 2/3. The 20 is no longer the denominator. The phrase 'given that' or 'among those who' names the new total. The SAT writes this with a short table more often than with the words 'conditional probability.'

Simplify the fraction unless the question wants a decimal or a percent. 8/12 is 2/3. The traps are using the wrong total, forgetting that 'not A' is the complement, and counting a number greater than the total, which makes a probability bigger than 1. A probability lives from 0 to 1, inclusive.
Probability of an event is favorable outcomes over total equally likely outcomes, when that model applies. Independent events multiply; mutually exclusive events add (and cannot both happen).
P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A and B)
Conditional language ('given that') restricts the denominator to the given group. Re-read the table headers before you divide.

explainUz.text: Holatlar teng ehtimolli bo'lsa, hodisaning ehtimoli — qulay holatlar sonini mumkin bo'lgan holatlar soniga bo'lish. 3 ta qizil va 5 ta ko'k marmarli qopda 8 ta marmar bor. Qizil ehtimoli 3/8. Ko'k ehtimoli 5/8. Ular 1 ga qo'shiladi, chunki faqat shu ranglar bor va ular ustma-ust tushmaydi.

Teskarisining, 'qizil emas' ning ehtimoli — 1 minus qizil ehtimoli. P(qizil) = 1/5 bo'lsa, P(qizil emas) = 4/5. Sanash ham mumkin: qulay bo'lmagan holatlar, o'sha jami ustida. Teng tangada P(gerb) = 1/2. Teng oltita yonli sharda P(juft) = 3/6 = 1/2, ya'ni 2, 4 va 6 yonlari.
P(hodisa) = qulay / jami, holatlar teng ehtimolli bo'lganda

Shartli ehtimollik jami ni kichraytiradi. 20 o'quvchili sinfda 12 tasi sport bilan shug'ullanadi va o'sha 12 tadan 8 tasi musiqa ham chaladi. Sportchilar orasidan o'quvchi tanlansa, u musiqa chalish ehtimoli 8/12 = 2/3. 20 endi maxraj emas. 'Berilgan bo'lsa' yoki 'shug'ullanadiganlar ichidan' iborasi yangi jami ni aytadi. SAT buni 'shartli ehtimollik' so'zidan ko'ra qisqa jadval bilan yozadi.

Savol o'nli kasr yoki foiz so'ramasa, kasrni qisqartiring. 8/12 bu 2/3. Tuzoqlar — noto'g'ri jami, 'A emas' to'ldiruvchi ekanini unutish va jamidan katta sonni sanash, bu ehtimollikni 1 dan katta qiladi. Ehtimollik 0 dan 1 gacha yashaydi, chegaralar bilan.

Hodisa ehtimolligi — model mos kelganda qulay natijalarning barcha teng ehtimolli natijalarga nisbati. Mustaqil hodisalar ko'payadi; bir-birini istisno qiluvchilar qo'shiladi (va ikkalasi birga bo'lmaydi).
P(A yoki B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A va B)
Shartli til ('agar ... berilgan') maxrajni berilgan guruhga qisqartiradi. Bo'lishdan oldin jadval sarlavhalarini qayta o'qing.

examples.promptEn: A bag has 3 red marbles and 5 blue marbles. One marble is drawn at random. What is the probability it is red?
examples.promptUz: Qopda 3 ta qizil va 5 ta ko'k marmar bor. Bittasi tasodifiy olinadi. U qizil bo'lish ehtimoli necha?
examples.gloss: at random — tasodifiy; probability — ehtimollik; drawn — olinadi

steps.en: The total is 3 + 5 = 8 marbles, all equally likely.
steps.uz: Jami 3 + 5 = 8 ta marmar, hammasi teng ehtimolli.

steps.en: Favorable outcomes are the 3 red marbles.
steps.uz: Qulay holatlar — 3 ta qizil marmar.

steps.en: The probability is 3/8. It is already simplified.
steps.uz: Ehtimollik 3/8. U allaqachon qisqargan.

examples.promptEn: Of 20 students, 12 play a sport, and 8 of those 12 also play music. A student is chosen at random from the students who play a sport. What is the probability the student plays music?
examples.promptUz: 20 o'quvchidan 12 tasi sport bilan shug'ullanadi va o'sha 12 tadan 8 tasi musiqa ham chaladi. Sportchilar orasidan o'quvchi tasodifiy tanlanadi. U musiqa chalish ehtimoli necha?
examples.gloss: given / among — ichidan; chosen at random — tasodifiy tanlanadi

steps.en: The phrase 'from the students who play a sport' makes the total 12, not 20.
steps.uz: 'Sportchilar orasidan' iborasi jami ni 12 qiladi, 20 emas.

steps.en: Favorable outcomes are the 8 who also play music. The probability is 8/12.
steps.uz: Qulay holatlar — musiqa ham chaladigan 8 ta. Ehtimollik 8/12.

steps.en: Simplify 8/12 = 2/3. A uses the whole class as the total. B is the share who play a sport. D is one half, which is not 8/12.
steps.uz: 8/12 = 2/3 ga qisqaradi. A butun sinfni jami qiladi. B sport bilan shug'ullanadigan ulush. D — yarim, bu 8/12 emas.

mistakes.en: Using the whole class as the denominator after the question has already restricted the group. Among the 12 athletes, the total is 12. 8/20 answers a different question: a student from the whole class who is an athlete and a musician.
mistakes.uz: Savol guruhni cheklab bo'lgandan keyin butun sinfni maxraj qilish. 12 sportchi ichida jami 12. 8/20 boshqa savolga javob: butun sinfdan sportchi ham, musiqachi ham bo'lgan o'quvchi.

mistakes.en: Forgetting the complement. If the probability of red is 1/5, the probability of not red is 4/5, not 1/5 and not 5/1.
mistakes.uz: To'ldiruvchini unutish. Qizil ehtimoli 1/5 bo'lsa, qizil emas ehtimoli 4/5, 1/5 emas va 5/1 ham emas.

mistakes.en: Leaving 8/12 unsimplified, or writing a probability greater than 1. 8 favorable out of 12 is 2/3. A count larger than the total is a counting error, not a probability.
mistakes.uz: 8/12 ni qisqartirmasdan qoldirish yoki 1 dan katta ehtimollik yozish. 12 tadan 8 qulay — 2/3. Jamidan katta sanoq — sanash xatosi, ehtimollik emas.

lessons.titleEn: Samples, margin of error, and claims
lessons.goalEn: Read an estimate with a margin of error as an interval, and say which claims that interval can support.
lessons.goalUz: Xato chegarali taxminni oraliq deb o'qish va o'sha oraliq qaysi da'voni ko'tara olishini aytish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can add and subtract percents and can tell a part of one school from a claim about a whole country.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar foizlarni qo'sha va ayira oladi hamda bitta maktabning qismini butun mamlakat haqidagi da'vodan ajrata oladi.

teacherEn.text: Write 62% ± 4% and draw the interval from 58 to 66 on a number line before any vocabulary. Ask whether 70 sits inside it. Then ask whether 'more than half' survives, since the whole interval is above 50.
Taxmin — bitta nuqta. Xato chegarasi o'sha nuqta atrofidagi ruxsat. Da'vo butun oraliqqa sig'sa, oraliq uni ko'taradi. Tanlanma qayerdan olingan bo'lsa, da'vo o'sha yerga tegishli.
One practice item is only the arithmetic of the endpoints. Another is the judgment. Do not skip the judgment.

teacherUz.text: 62% ± 4% yozing va lug'atdan oldin 58 dan 66 gacha oraliqni son o'qiga chizing. 70 uning ichidami, deb so'rang. So'ng 'yarmidan ko'p' yashaydimi, deb so'rang, chunki butun oraliq 50 dan yuqorida.
Taxmin — bitta nuqta. Xato chegarasi o'sha nuqta atrofidagi ruxsat. Da'vo butun oraliqqa sig'sa, oraliq uni ko'taradi. Tanlanma qayerdan olingan bo'lsa, da'vo o'sha yerga tegishli.
Bitta mashq faqat chekkaning hisobi. Boshqasi hukm. Hukmni tashlab ketmang.

explainEn.text: A sample is a part of a group, chosen so that it can stand in for the group. A random sample from one school can support a careful claim about that school. It cannot support a claim about every school in the country. The place the sample came from is the place the claim may talk about. A voluntary online form is a weaker sample than a random one, because the people who choose to answer are not the whole group.

An estimate with a margin of error is an interval, not a single exact percent. 62% with a margin of error of 4 percentage points runs from 62 − 4 = 58 to 62 + 4 = 66. A claim is supported when the entire interval agrees with it. 'More than half' is supported here, because even the low end, 58, is above 50. 'At least 70%' is not supported, because 70 is outside the interval.
interval = estimate − margin to estimate + margin

Percentage points are the unit of the margin. A margin of 4 percentage points is not a 4% change of the 62. You add and subtract 4 from 62. You do not multiply 62 by 0.04 for the margin itself. The percent-change lesson and this lesson use the word percent differently. Read whether the stem says 'percentage points' or 'percent of.'

The SAT asks for an endpoint, whether a number is plausible, or whether a claim reaches beyond the sampled group. Compute the interval first. Then hold the claim up to the whole interval, not to the center alone. A claim that fits the center and misses the low end is not supported.
A sample estimates a population; a margin of error sketches a plausible range around that estimate. Claims that leap from sample to 'every' or 'proves' go beyond what the data support.
Larger random samples tend to shrink margin of error; biased samples do not become honest by growing. The SAT tests whether you notice the bias, not whether you compute a fancy interval.
Rewrite the claim in one cautious sentence before judging it. Caution is the skill being scored.

explainUz.text: Tanlanma — guruhning bir qismi, guruh o'rnini bosa oladigan qilib tanlangan. Bitta maktabdan olingan tasodifiy tanlanma o'sha maktab haqidagi ehtiyot da'voni ko'tara oladi. U mamlakatdagi har bir maktab haqidagi da'voni ko'tara olmaydi. Tanlanma qayerdan olingan bo'lsa, da'vo o'sha yer haqida gapirishi mumkin. Ixtiyoriy onlayn forma tasodifiy tanlanmadan zaifroq, chunki javob berishni o'zi xohlagan odamlar butun guruh emas.

Xato chegarali taxmin — oraliq, bitta aniq foiz emas. 4 foiz punkti xato chegarali 62% soni 62 − 4 = 58 dan 62 + 4 = 66 gacha yuradi. Da'vo butun oraliq unga rozi bo'lsagina ko'tariladi. 'Yarmidan ko'p' bu yerda ko'tariladi, chunki hatto past chekka, 58, 50 dan yuqori. 'Kamida 70%' ko'tarilmaydi, chunki 70 oraliqdan tashqarida.
oraliq = taxmin − chegara dan taxmin + chegara gacha

Foiz punkti — chegaraning o'lchovi. 4 foiz punkti chegara — 62 ning 4 foiz o'zgarishi emas. 62 ga 4 ni qo'shasiz va ayirasiz. Chegaraning o'zi uchun 62 ni 0.04 ga ko'paytirmaysiz. Foiz o'zgarishi darsi va bu dars 'foiz' so'zini turlicha ishlatadi. Matn 'foiz punkti' deyaptimi yoki 'foizi' deyaptimi, o'qing.

SAT chekkani, son ishonarli yoki yo'qligini yoki da'vo tanlangan guruhdan tashqariga chiqishini so'raydi. Avval oraliqni hisoblang. So'ng da'voni faqat markazga emas, butun oraliqqa tuting. Markazga sig'ib, past chekkaga sig'maydigan da'vo ko'tarilmaydi.
Tanlanma populyatsiyani baholaydi; xato chegarasi shu baho atrofida ehtimoliy oralik chizadi. Tanlanmadan 'har bir' yoki 'isbotlaydi' ga sakragan da'volar ma'lumot ko'tara oladiganidan oshadi.

Kattaroq tasodifiy tanlanmalar xato chegarasini kichraytirishga moyil; tarafkash tanlanma kattalashib rostgo'y bo'lmaydi. SAT tarafkashlikni sezishingizni sinaydi, murakkab interval hisoblashingizni emas.
Da'voni baholashdan oldin ehtiyotkor bitta gap bilan qayta yozing. Ehtiyot — baholanayotgan mahorat.

examples.promptEn: An estimate is 62% with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. What is the lower end of the interval?
examples.promptUz: Taxmin 62%, xato chegarasi 4 foiz punkti. Oraliqning past chekkasi necha?
examples.gloss: margin of error — xato chegarasi; percentage points — foiz punkti; estimate — taxmin

steps.en: The lower end is the estimate minus the margin.
steps.uz: Past chekka — taxmin minus chegara.

steps.en: Subtract the margin from the estimate: 62 − 4 = 58.
steps.uz: Taxmindan chegarani ayiring: 62 − 4 = 58.

steps.en: The interval runs from 58% to 66%. The question asked for the lower end, 58.
steps.uz: Oraliq 58% dan 66% gacha. Savol past chekkani so'radi, 58.

examples.promptEn: A random sample gives the estimate 62% with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. Which claim is supported by the entire interval?
examples.promptUz: Tasodifiy tanlanma 4 foiz punkti xato chegarasi bilan 62% taxmin beradi. Butun oraliq qaysi da'voni ko'taradi?
examples.gloss: supported — ko'tariladi; entire interval — butun oraliq; claim — da'vo

steps.en: The interval is 58 to 66. Every number in it is above 50.
steps.uz: Oraliq 58 dan 66 gacha. Uning ichidagi har bir son 50 dan yuqori.

steps.en: So 'greater than 50' is supported by the entire interval.
steps.uz: Demak '50 dan katta' ni butun oraliq ko'taradi.

steps.en: A requires 70, which is outside. C treats the estimate as exact. D is the opposite of the interval.
steps.uz: A 70 ni talab qiladi, u tashqarida. C taxminni aniq deb oladi. D oraliqning teskarisi.

examples.answer: B. greater than 50; the interval starts at 58

mistakes.en: Multiplying the estimate by the margin. A margin of 4 percentage points around 62 is 58 to 66. It is not 62 × 0.04. That product is a percent of 62, a different question.
mistakes.uz: Taxminni chegaraga ko'paytirish. 62 atrofidagi 4 foiz punkti chegara — 58 dan 66 gacha. Bu 62 × 0.04 emas. O'sha ko'paytma 62 ning foizi, boshqa savol.

mistakes.en: Supporting a claim from the center alone. 62 is above 50, and so is the whole interval, so 'more than half' stands. A claim of 'at least 70' fits neither the center nor the interval.
mistakes.uz: Da'voni faqat markazdan ko'tarish. 62 soni 50 dan yuqori va butun oraliq ham shunday, demak 'yarmidan ko'p' turadi. 'Kamida 70' da'vosi na markazga, na oraliqqa sig'adi.

mistakes.en: Letting a sample from one school speak for the whole country. The estimate can be careful and still be about the wrong group. The sampled population is the population in the claim.
mistakes.uz: Bitta maktabdan olingan tanlanmani butun mamlakat nomidan gapirtirish. Taxmin ehtiyot bo'lishi mumkin va baribir noto'g'ri guruh haqida. Tanlangan to'da — da'vodagi to'da.

introEn.text: Seven lessons on angles, similar triangles, right triangles, sine cosine and tangent, area, volume, and circles. Several formulas are on the reference sheet. The lesson is knowing which length is the height, the radius, or the opposite side.

introUz.text: Yetti dars: burchak, o'xshash uchburchak, to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak, sinus kosinus va tangens, yuza, hajm va aylana. Bir necha formula varaqada. Dars — qaysi uzunlik balandlik, radius yoki qarama-qarshi tomon ekanini bilish.

lessons.goalEn: Use 180° on a straight line, 90° in a right angle, vertical angles, and the equal angles a transversal makes with parallel lines.
lessons.goalUz: To'g'ri chiziqdagi 180°, to'g'ri burchakdagi 90°, vertikal burchaklar va parallel chiziqlarni kesuvchi yasagan teng burchaklardan foydalanish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can solve a linear equation and can subtract from 180 and from 90.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar chiziqli tenglamani yecha oladi hamda 180 va 90 dan ayira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Draw one straight line and a ray sticking out of it. Label one angle 40° and ask for the neighbor. Do not say 'supplementary' until someone has said 140. Then draw two parallel lines and one transversal.
To'g'ri chiziqdagi qo'shni burchaklar 180 ga to'ldiradi. Vertikal burchaklar teng. Parallel chiziqlarda mos burchaklar teng, ichki bir tomonlama burchaklar 180 ga to'ldiradi.
The SAT example is an equation hiding in a pair of corresponding angles. Translate 'corresponding' as 'the same job at the other parallel' before solving.

teacherUz.text: Bitta to'g'ri chiziq va undan chiqqan nur chizing. Bitta burchakni 40° deb belgilang va qo'shnisini so'rang. Kimdir 140 demaguncha 'qo'shni' so'zini atamang. So'ng ikki parallel va bitta kesuvchi chizing.
To'g'ri chiziqdagi qo'shni burchaklar 180 ga to'ldiradi. Vertikal burchaklar teng. Parallel chiziqlarda mos burchaklar teng, ichki bir tomonlama burchaklar 180 ga to'ldiradi.
SAT misoli — mos burchaklar juftida yashiringan tenglama. Yechishdan oldin 'corresponding' ni 'ikkinchi parallelning o'sha ishi' deb tarjima qiling.

explainEn.text: Angles on a straight line add to 180°. If one is 40°, the adjacent one is 140°. Angles that form a right angle add to 90°. If one is 28°, the complement is 62°. Vertical angles, the opposite angles made by two crossing lines, are equal. If one is 130°, the vertical angle is 130°, and the neighbors are 50°.

When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal. They sit in the same position at each intersection, both above the parallel and both to the right of the transversal, for example. Alternate interior angles, inside the parallels and on opposite sides of the transversal, are also equal. Consecutive interior angles, inside and on the same side, add to 180°.
straight line 180°, right angle 90°, parallel lines copy the angle

The SAT often gives the angles as expressions. If a corresponding pair is 3x and 2x + 20, then 3x = 2x + 20, so x = 20 and the angle is 60°. You are not guessing a picture. You are writing the equality the parallel lines promised, then solving the equation from Lesson 2.2.

A figure is not always drawn to scale. Do not measure with your eyes when an equation is available. The traps are subtracting from 90 when the angles sit on a straight line, and setting consecutive interior angles equal instead of supplementary.

Vertical angles are equal; adjacent angles on a straight line sum to 180°. When a transversal crosses parallel lines, corresponding and alternate interior angles match; consecutive interior angles are supplementary.
Mark the parallel arrows on the diagram before you chase angles. Unmarked parallels are not parallels.
On the SAT, a missing angle is often one equation away once you label every angle you know. Write the relation before you solve for the number.

explainUz.text: To'g'ri chiziqdagi burchaklar yig'indisi 180°. Bittasi 40° bo'lsa, qo'shnisi 140°. To'g'ri burchak hosil qilgan burchaklar yig'indisi 90°. Bittasi 28° bo'lsa, to'ldiruvchisi 62°. Vertikal burchaklar, ikki kesishgan chiziq yasagan qarama-qarshi burchaklar, teng. Bittasi 130° bo'lsa, vertikal burchak 130°, qo'shnilari 50°.

Kesuvchi ikki parallel chiziqni kessa, mos burchaklar teng. Ular har bir kesishmada bir xil joyda turadi, masalan ikkalasi ham parallelning ustida va kesuvchining o'ngida. Ichki almashinuvchi burchaklar, parallellarning ichida va kesuvchining qarama-qarshi tomonida, ham teng. Ichki bir tomonlama burchaklar, ichida va bir tomonda, 180° ga to'ldiradi.
to'g'ri chiziq 180°, to'g'ri burchak 90°, parallel chiziqlar burchakni nusxalaydi

SAT burchaklarni ko'pincha ifoda qilib beradi. Mos juft 3x va 2x + 20 bo'lsa, 3x = 2x + 20, demak x = 20 va burchak 60°. Siz rasmni ko'z bilan taxmin qilmayapsiz. Parallel chiziqlar va'da qilgan tenglikni yozasiz, so'ng 2.2-darsdagi tenglamani yechasiz.

Shakl har doim masshtabda chizilmaydi. Tenglama bor ekan, ko'z bilan o'lchamang. Tuzoqlar — burchaklar to'g'ri chiziqda turganda 90 dan ayirish va ichki bir tomonlama burchaklarni to'ldiruvchi o'rniga teng deb olish.

Vertikal burchaklar teng; to'g'ri chiziqdagi qo'shni burchaklar yig'indisi 180°. Kesuvchi parallel chiziqlarni kesganda mos va almashinuvchi ichki burchaklar teng; ketma-ket ichki burchaklar qo'shimcha.
Burchak quvguncha diagrammada parallel strelkalarni belgilang. Belgilanmagan parallellar — parallel emas.
SAT da yetishmayotgan burchak ko'pincha bilgan burchaklaringizni yozgach bitta tenglama uzoqlikda. Sonni topishdan oldin munosabatni yozing.

examples.promptEn: Two adjacent angles form a straight line. One measures 40°. What is the other?
examples.promptUz: Ikki qo'shni burchak to'g'ri chiziq hosil qiladi. Bittasi 40°. Ikkinchisi necha gradus?
examples.gloss: adjacent — qo'shni; straight line — to'g'ri chiziq

steps.en: Angles on a straight line add to 180°.
steps.uz: To'g'ri chiziqdagi burchaklar yig'indisi 180°.

steps.en: The other angle is 180 − 40.
steps.uz: Ikkinchi burchak 180 − 40.

steps.en: 180 − 40 = 140. The angles are 40° and 140°.

examples.promptEn: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A pair of corresponding angles measures 3x degrees and 2x + 20 degrees. What is the measure of each angle?
examples.promptUz: Ikki parallel chiziqni kesuvchi kesib o'tadi. Mos burchaklar jufti 3x gradus va 2x + 20 gradus. Har bir burchak necha gradus?
examples.gloss: corresponding angles — mos burchaklar; transversal — kesuvchi; parallel — parallel

steps.en: Corresponding angles are equal, so 3x = 2x + 20.
steps.uz: Mos burchaklar teng, demak 3x = 2x + 20.

steps.en: Subtract 2x: x = 20. The angle is 3(20) = 60. The other expression gives 40 + 20 = 60 too.
steps.uz: 2x ni ayiring: x = 20. Burchak 3(20) = 60. Ikkinchi ifoda ham 40 + 20 = 60 beradi.

steps.en: A is the value of x, not the angle. B is 2x. D is what you get if you add 20 to 3x without solving.
steps.uz: A — x ning qiymati, burchak emas. B — 2x. D — yechmasdan 3x ga 20 qo'shish.

mistakes.en: Subtracting a straight-line neighbor from 90. Neighbors on a line add to 180. Neighbors in a corner add to 90. Look at the picture before you choose 180 or 90.
mistakes.uz: To'g'ri chiziqdagi qo'shnini 90 dan ayirish. Chiziqdagi qo'shnilar 180 ga qo'shiladi. Burchak ichidagi qo'shnilar 90 ga qo'shiladi. 180 yoki 90 ni tanlashdan oldin rasmga qarang.

mistakes.en: Setting consecutive interior angles equal. On parallel lines they add to 180. Corresponding and alternate interior angles are the ones that are equal.
mistakes.uz: Ichki bir tomonlama burchaklarni teng deb olish. Parallel chiziqlarda ular 180 ga qo'shiladi. Teng bo'ladiganlari — mos va ichki almashinuvchi burchaklar.

mistakes.en: Reporting x when the question asks for the angle. If x = 20 and the angle is 3x, the answer is 60 unless the stem says 'what is x.'
mistakes.uz: Savol burchakni so'raganda x ni yozish. x = 20 va burchak 3x bo'lsa, matn 'x necha' demasa, javob 60.

lessons.goalEn: Find a missing angle from 180°, and scale corresponding sides of similar triangles.
lessons.goalUz: 180° dan yetishmayotgan burchakni topish va o'xshash uchburchaklarning mos tomonlarini masshtablash.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can subtract from 180 and can solve a proportion.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar 180 dan ayira oladi va proporsiyani yecha oladi.

teacherEn.text: Draw a triangle, label 50° and 60°, and ask for the third before you mention similarity. Then draw a 3-4-5 triangle and a 6-8-10 triangle and ask what stayed the same.
Uchburchakning burchaklari 180 ga yig'iladi. O'xshash shakllar — bir xil shakl, boshqa o'lcham. Tomonlar bir xil songa ko'payadi. Burchaklar o'zgarmaydi.
When you scale, write the fraction big/small once and use it on every side. Do not invent a new ratio for each side.

teacherUz.text: Uchburchak chizing, 50° va 60° ni belgilang va o'xshashlikni aytishdan oldin uchinchisini so'rang. So'ng 3-4-5 va 6-8-10 uchburchaklarini chizing va nima o'zgarmaganini so'rang.
Uchburchakning burchaklari 180 ga yig'iladi. O'xshash shakllar — bir xil shakl, boshqa o'lcham. Tomonlar bir xil songa ko'payadi. Burchaklar o'zgarmaydi.
Masshtablaganda katta/kichik kasrini bir marta yozing va har bir tomonda ishlating. Har tomon uchun yangi nisbat o'ylab topmang.

explainEn.text: The interior angles of a triangle add to 180°. If two angles are 50° and 60°, the third is 180 − 50 − 60 = 70°. An isosceles triangle has two equal sides and the base angles opposite those sides are equal. If the vertex angle is 40°, the two base angles share the remaining 140°, so each is 70°.

Similar figures have the same shape and possibly a different size. Corresponding angles are equal. Corresponding sides are proportional, multiplied by one scale factor. A 3-4-5 triangle and a 6-8-10 triangle are similar with scale factor 2. The perimeter scales by the same factor: 12 becomes 24. Area would scale by the square of the factor, which is a later caution, not today's question unless the stem says area.
third angle = 180° − the other two

If a side of 4 on the small triangle corresponds to a side of 10 on the large one, the scale factor is 10/4 = 5/2. A side of 6 on the small triangle corresponds to 6 × 5/2 = 15 on the large one. The SAT gives two similar triangles and one missing side. Match the sides by the angles they sit between, or by the order the problem states, then use one ratio.

The traps are adding the angles to something other than 180, using different scale factors for different sides, and scaling the perimeter by the square of the factor. Perimeter is a length. It scales once.
Similar triangles have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides. AA is enough to prove similarity. The scale factor multiplies lengths; its square multiplies areas.
Write the correspondence of vertices in order: △ABC ~ △DEF means A↔D, B↔E, C↔F. A wrong correspondence silently swaps sides.
Trace the two triangles with different colors or hatch marks. Correspondence becomes visible when the shapes are marked.

explainUz.text: Uchburchakning ichki burchaklari yig'indisi 180°. Ikki burchak 50° va 60° bo'lsa, uchinchisi 180 − 50 − 60 = 70°. Teng yonli uchburchakning ikki tomoni teng va o'sha tomonlar qarshisidagi asos burchaklari teng. Uch burchak 40° bo'lsa, ikki asos burchagi qolgan 140° ni bo'lishadi, har biri 70°.

O'xshash shakllarning shakli bir xil, o'lchami boshqa bo'lishi mumkin. Mos burchaklar teng. Mos tomonlar proporsional, bitta masshtab ko'paytuvchisiga ko'payadi. 3-4-5 va 6-8-10 uchburchaklari masshtab 2 bilan o'xshash. Perimetr ham o'sha ko'paytuvchiga o'sadi: 12 dan 24 ga. Yuza ko'paytuvchining kvadratiga o'sardi, bu keyingi ehtiyot, savol yuza demasa bugungi savol emas.
uchinchi burchak = 180° − qolgan ikkisi

Kichik uchburchakdagi 4 tomon kattadagi 10 tomonga mos bo'lsa, masshtab 10/4 = 5/2. Kichikdagi 6 tomon kattada 6 × 5/2 = 15 ga mos. SAT ikkita o'xshash uchburchak va bitta yetishmayotgan tomon beradi. Tomonlarni ular orasidagi burchaklar yoki masala aytgan tartib bilan juftlang, so'ng bitta nisbatni ishlating.
Tuzoqlar — burchaklarni 180 dan boshqa songa qo'shish, turli tomonlarga turli masshtab ishlatish va perimetrni ko'paytuvchining kvadratiga o'stirish. Perimetr — uzunlik. U bir marta masshtablanadi.

O'xshash uchburchaklarning mos burchaklari teng, mos tomonlari proporsional. AA o'xshashlikni isbotlashga yetadi. Masshtab koeffitsienti uzunliklarni ko'paytiradi; uning kvadrati yuzalarni ko'paytiradi.
Uchlar muvofiqligini tartibda yozing: △ABC ~ △DEF demak A↔D, B↔E, C↔F. Noto'g'ri muvofiqlik tomonlarni jim almashtiradi.
Ikki uchburchakni turli rang yoki chiziqlar bilan belgilang. Shakllar belgilanganda muvofiqlik ko'rinadi.

examples.promptEn: Two angles of a triangle measure 50° and 60°. What is the third angle?
examples.promptUz: Uchburchakning ikki burchagi 50° va 60°. Uchinchi burchak necha gradus?

steps.en: The three angles add to 180°.
steps.uz: Uch burchak yig'indisi 180°.

steps.en: The known two add to 110°.
steps.uz: Ma'lum ikkisi 110° ga qo'shiladi.

steps.en: The third is 180 − 110 = 70.
steps.uz: Uchinchisi 180 − 110 = 70.

examples.promptEn: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides. A side of length 4 corresponds to a side of length 10. What length corresponds to a side of length 6?
examples.promptUz: Ikki o'xshash uchburchakning mos tomonlari bor. Uzunligi 4 bo'lgan tomon uzunligi 10 bo'lgan tomonga mos. Uzunligi 6 bo'lgan tomonga qanday uzunlik mos?
examples.gloss: similar — o'xshash; corresponding — mos; length — uzunlik

steps.en: The scale factor from the small triangle to the large one is 10/4 = 5/2.
steps.uz: Kichikdan kattaga masshtab 10/4 = 5/2.

steps.en: Multiply the side of 6 by that factor: 6 × 5/2 = 15.
steps.uz: 6 tomonni o'sha ko'paytuvchiga ko'paytiring: 6 × 5/2 = 15.

steps.en: A doubles 6, using a scale of 2 instead of 5/2. D scales the side of 9 by 5/2, the other side of a 4-6-9 triangle, which this question did not ask for.
steps.uz: A 6 ni ikki baravar qiladi, 5/2 o'rniga masshtab 2. D 4-6-9 uchburchagining 9 tomonini 5/2 ga o'stiradi, savol uni so'ramagan.

mistakes.en: Using a new ratio for each side. One pair of corresponding sides sets the scale factor. Every other pair uses that same factor.
mistakes.uz: Har tomon uchun yangi nisbat. Mos tomonlarning bitta jufti masshtabni belgilaydi. Qolgan har bir juft o'sha ko'paytuvchini ishlatadi.

mistakes.en: Forgetting a triangle has three angles. Two angles of 40° and 80° leave 60°, not 100° from a straight line and not 260° from a full turn.
mistakes.uz: Uchburchakning uch burchagi borligini unutish. 40° va 80° dan keyin 60° qoladi, to'g'ri chiziqdagi 100° emas va to'liq aylanishdagi 260° ham emas.

mistakes.en: Scaling a perimeter by the square of the factor. A scale of 2 doubles the perimeter. It multiplies the area by 4. The question's noun decides which one.
mistakes.uz: Perimetrni ko'paytuvchining kvadratiga o'stirish. Masshtab 2 perimetrni ikki baravar qiladi. Yuzani 4 ga ko'paytiradi. Savolning oti qaysi biri ekanini hal qiladi.

lessons.goalEn: Find a missing side of a right triangle, and use the side ratios of 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 triangles.
lessons.goalUz: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning yetishmayotgan tomonini topish va 45-45-90 hamda 30-60-90 uchburchaklarining tomon nisbatlaridan foydalanish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can square a whole number, take a square root, and simplify a radical such as √2.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar butun sonni kvadratga oshira oladi, kvadrat ildiz ola oladi va √2 kabi radikalni soddalashtira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Put the 3-4-5 triangle from the figure on the board and check 3² + 4² = 5² before you write the theorem. The picture has to earn the formula.

To'g'ri burchakning ikki kateti kvadratlari qo'shilsa, gipotenuza kvadrati chiqadi. Gipotenuza — eng uzun tomon, to'g'ri burchakning qarshisida. 45-45-90 da tomonlar x, x, x√2. 30-60-90 da x, x√3, 2x.
Tell them these two special triangles are on the reference sheet. The skill is recognizing which one the picture is.

teacherUz.text: Rasmdagi 3-4-5 uchburchagini doskaga qo'ying va teoremani yozishdan oldin 3² + 4² = 5² ni tekshiring. Rasm formula ni o'zi isbotlashi kerak.

To'g'ri burchakning ikki kateti kvadratlari qo'shilsa, gipotenuza kvadrati chiqadi. Gipotenuza — eng uzun tomon, to'g'ri burchakning qarshisida. 45-45-90 da tomonlar x, x, x√2. 30-60-90 da x, x√3, 2x.
Ayting: bu ikki maxsus uchburchak varaqada bor. Mahorat — rasm qaysi biri ekanini tanish.

explainEn.text: In a right triangle the two legs meet at the right angle and the hypotenuse is the side opposite that angle, the longest side. The Pythagorean theorem says a² + b² = c², where c is the hypotenuse. For legs 6 and 8, c² = 36 + 64 = 100, so c = 10. This is the 3-4-5 triangle doubled. Other useful multiples are 5-12-13 and 7-24-25. If you know the hypotenuse and one leg, subtract: 13² − 5² = 144, so the other leg is 12.

A 45-45-90 triangle is isosceles. The legs are equal. If each leg is x, the hypotenuse is x√2. If the hypotenuse is 10, each leg is 10/√2 = 5√2. A 30-60-90 triangle has sides x, x√3, and 2x, in that order: the side opposite 30° is the short leg x, the side opposite 60° is x√3, and the side opposite 90° is 2x. If the hypotenuse is 12, the short leg is 6 and the long leg is 6√3.
a² + b² = c², with c the hypotenuse

Not every triple is a right triangle. For 7, 8, and 11, 7² + 8² = 49 + 64 = 113, and 11² = 121. They are not equal, so the triangle is not right. The SAT asks for a missing side, for which side is the hypotenuse, or for a special-triangle length in simplest radical form. The traps are adding the legs instead of their squares, putting a leg on the c side of the formula, and swapping the 30-60-90 sides.
In a right triangle, a² + b² = c² with c the hypotenuse. The 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 patterns are on the reference sheet — memorize the shape of the ratios so you recognize them without re-deriving.
Identify the right angle first, then the hypotenuse. Students who square the wrong side invent a false Pythagorean triple.

explainUz.text: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda ikki katet to'g'ri burchakda uchrashadi va gipotenuza o'sha burchakning qarshisidagi tomon, eng uzuni. Pifagor teoremasi a² + b² = c² deydi, c — gipotenuza. Katetlar 6 va 8 bo'lsa, c² = 36 + 64 = 100, demak c = 10. Bu ikki baravar 3-4-5. Boshqa foydali karralilar 5-12-13 va 7-24-25. Gipotenuza va bitta katet ma'lum bo'lsa, ayiring: 13² − 5² = 144, demak ikkinchi katet 12.

45-45-90 uchburchagi teng yonli. Katetlar teng. Har bir katet x bo'lsa, gipotenuza x√2. Gipotenuza 10 bo'lsa, har bir katet 10/√2 = 5√2. 30-60-90 uchburchagining tomonlari x, x√3 va 2x, shu tartibda: 30° qarshisidagi tomon qisqa katet x, 60° qarshisidagi x√3, 90° qarshisidagi 2x. Gipotenuza 12 bo'lsa, qisqa katet 6 va uzun katet 6√3.
a² + b² = c², c — gipotenuza

Har bir uchlik to'g'ri burchakli emas. 7, 8 va 11 uchun 7² + 8² = 49 + 64 = 113, va 11² = 121. Ular teng emas, demak uchburchak to'g'ri burchakli emas. SAT yetishmayotgan tomonni, qaysi tomon gipotenuza ekanini yoki maxsus uchburchak uzunligini sodda radikalda so'raydi. Tuzoqlar — katetlarni kvadrat o'rniga qo'shish, katetni formula dagi c tomoniga qo'yish va 30-60-90 tomonlarini almashtirish.
To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda a² + b² = c², c gipotenuza. 45-45-90 va 30-60-90 qoliplari varaqada — nisbatlar shaklini yodlang, qayta chiqarmasdan taniysiz.
Avval to'g'ri burchakni, so'ng gipotenuzani toping. Noto'g'ri tomonni kvadratga olgan o'quvchi soxta Pifagor uchligini yasaydi.

examples.promptEn: A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is the hypotenuse?
examples.promptUz: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari 6 va 8. Gipotenuza necha?
examples.gloss: legs — katetlar; hypotenuse — gipotenuza; right triangle — to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak

steps.en: The legs are a and b. The hypotenuse is c. So 6² + 8² = c².
steps.uz: Katetlar a va b. Gipotenuza c. Demak 6² + 8² = c².

steps.en: c = 10, the positive length. This is a 3-4-5 triangle with every side doubled.
steps.uz: c = 10, musbat uzunlik. Bu har tomoni ikki baravar 3-4-5 uchburchagi.

examples.promptEn: A 45-45-90 triangle has hypotenuse 10. What is the length of each leg?
examples.promptUz: 45-45-90 uchburchagining gipotenuzasi 10. Har bir katetning uzunligi necha?

steps.en: The hypotenuse is the leg times √2. So x√2 = 10 and x = 10/√2.
steps.uz: Gipotenuza — katet marta √2. Demak x√2 = 10 va x = 10/√2.

steps.en: A divides by 2 and drops the radical. C multiplies by √2 instead of dividing. Each leg is 5√2.
steps.uz: A 2 ga bo'ladi va radikalni tashlaydi. C bo'lish o'rniga √2 ga ko'paytiradi. Har bir katet 5√2.

mistakes.en: Adding the legs instead of their squares. Legs 6 and 8 do not make a hypotenuse of 14. They make 6² + 8² = 100, so the hypotenuse is 10.
mistakes.uz: Katetlarni kvadratlari o'rniga qo'shish. 6 va 8 katetlar gipotenuzani 14 qilmaydi. Ular 6² + 8² = 100 qiladi, demak gipotenuza 10.

mistakes.en: Putting a leg in the c position. c is always the hypotenuse, the side opposite the right angle. If you know c and one leg, subtract the square. Do not add.
mistakes.uz: Katetni c o'rniga qo'yish. c doim gipotenuza, to'g'ri burchakning qarshisidagi tomon. c va bitta katet ma'lum bo'lsa, kvadratni ayiring. Qo'shmang.

mistakes.en: Swapping the 30-60-90 sides. The side opposite 30° is half the hypotenuse, not the side opposite 60°. Opposite 60° is the short leg times √3.
mistakes.uz: 30-60-90 tomonlarini almashtirish. 30° qarshisidagi tomon gipotenuzaning yarmi, 60° qarshisidagi emas. 60° qarshisida qisqa katet marta √3.

lessons.figureCaptionEn: A 3-4-5 right triangle. The right angle sits between the sides of length 3 and 4. The hypotenuse is 5.
lessons.figureCaptionUz: 3-4-5 to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak. To'g'ri burchak uzunligi 3 va 4 bo'lgan tomonlar orasida. Gipotenuza 5.

lessons.goalEn: Write sin, cos, and tan of an acute angle as fractions in a right triangle, and recover a missing side from a  Pythagorean triple.
lessons.goalUz: O'tkir burchakning sin, cos va tan ini to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakdagi kasrlar deb yozish va Pifagor uchligidan yetishmayotgan tomonni tiklash.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can name the hypotenuse and the legs, and can simplify a fraction such as 6/8.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar gipotenuza va katetlarni ayta oladi hamda 6/8 kabi kasrni qisqartira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Stand at the angle opposite the side of length 3 in the 3-4-5 figure. Have the class point to opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse before any abbreviation. Then write the three fractions.

Sinus — qarama-qarshi katet bo'lingan gipotenuza. Kosinus — yondosh katet bo'lingan gipotenuza. Tangens — qarama-qarshi bo'lingan yondosh. Uchala si ham kasr. Burchak o'zgarsa, qarama-qarshi va yondosh joy almashadi.
A ramp is the SAT picture: rise over run is tangent. Say that out loud.

teacherUz.text: 3-4-5 rasmidagi uzunligi 3 bo'lgan tomon qarshisidagi burchakda turing. Qisqartmadan oldin sinf qarama-qarshi, yondosh va gipotenuzani ko'rsatsin. So'ng uchta kasrni yozing.

Sinus — qarama-qarshi katet bo'lingan gipotenuza. Kosinus — yondosh katet bo'lingan gipotenuza. Tangens — qarama-qarshi bo'lingan yondosh. Uchala si ham kasr. Burchak o'zgarsa, qarama-qarshi va yondosh joy almashadi.
Pandus — SAT rasmi: ko'tarilish bo'lingan yugurish — tangens. Buni ovoz chiqarib ayting.

explainEn.text: Pick an acute angle in a right triangle. The opposite side is the leg across from that angle. The adjacent side is the other leg, the one touching the angle. The hypotenuse is still the longest side, opposite the right angle. It is never the adjacent side of an acute angle.
sin = opposite / hypotenuse
cos = adjacent / hypotenuse
tan = opposite / adjacent

In the 3-4-5 triangle, for the angle opposite the side of length 3, sin = 3/5, cos = 4/5, and tan = 3/4. If you move to the other acute angle, opposite and adjacent swap: sin becomes 4/5 and cos becomes 3/5. Tangent becomes 4/3. The names are relative to the angle you chose.

A ramp that rises 3 meters over a horizontal 4 meters makes an angle with the ground whose tangent is 3/4. The hypotenuse of that ramp is 5, so the sine of the angle is 3/5. You do not need a decimal from a calculator if the triangle is a known triple. If cos = 5/13 and the angle is acute, the adjacent side is 5 and the hypotenuse is 13, so the opposite side is 12 by 5-12-13, and sin = 12/13. The identity sin² + cos² = 1 is the Pythagorean theorem in fraction clothes.

The SAT asks for one of the three ratios, or for a side once a ratio is given. The traps are swapping opposite and adjacent, putting a leg in the denominator of sine, and using the rounded calculator decimal when an exact fraction is available.

In a right triangle, sine is opposite/hypotenuse, cosine adjacent/hypotenuse, tangent opposite/adjacent. SOH-CAH-TOA is a memory hook, not a substitute for labeling the sides relative to the angle in play.
The angle matters: switching which acute angle you stand at swaps opposite and adjacent. Complementary angles swap sine and cosine.
Draw a tiny altitude mark on the opposite side before writing the ratio. The picture locks the definition.

explainUz.text: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda o'tkir burchakni tanlang. Qarama-qarshi tomon — o'sha burchakning qarshisidagi katet. Yondosh tomon — ikkinchi katet, burchakka tegib turgani. Gipotenuza hali ham eng uzun tomon, to'g'ri burchakning qarshisida. U o'tkir burchakning yondosh tomoni bo'lmaydi.
sin = qarama-qarshi / gipotenuza
cos = yondosh / gipotenuza
tan = qarama-qarshi / yondosh

3-4-5 uchburchakda uzunligi 3 bo'lgan tomon qarshisidagi burchak uchun sin = 3/5, cos = 4/5 va tan = 3/4. Ikkinchi o'tkir burchakka o'tsangiz, qarama-qarshi va yondosh almashadi: sin 4/5 bo'ladi, cos 3/5. Tangens 4/3 bo'ladi. Nomlar siz tanlagan burchakka nisbatan.

3 metr ko'tarilib, gorizontal 4 metr yoyilgan pandus yer bilan shunday burchak yasaydiki, uning tangensi 3/4. O'sha pandusning gipotenuzasi 5, demak burchakning sinusi 3/5. Uchlik ma'lum bo'lsa, kalkulyatordan o'nli kasr kerak emas. cos = 5/13 va burchak o'tkir bo'lsa, yondosh tomon 5 va gipotenuza 13, demak qarama-qarshi tomon 5-12-13 bo'yicha 12 va sin = 12/13. sin² + cos² = 1 ayniyati — kasr kiyimidagi Pifagor teoremasi.

SAT uchta nisbatdan bittasini yoki nisbat berilganda tomonni so'raydi. Tuzoqlar — qarama-qarshi va yondoshni almashtirish, sinusning maxrajiga katet qo'yish va aniq kasr bor ekan, yaxlitlangan kalkulyator o'nli kasridan foydalanish.

To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda sinus — qarama-qarshi/gipotenuza, kosinus — yondosh/gipotenuza, tangens — qarama-qarshi/yondosh. SOH-CAH-TOA — yodlash ilgagi, ishlatilayotgan burchakka nisbatan tomonlarni belgilashning o'rnini bosmaydi.
Burchak muhim: qaysi o'tmas burchakda turishingizni almashtirish qarama-qarshi va yondoshni almashtiradi. Komplementar burchaklar sinus va kosinusni almashtiradi.
Nisbat yozishdan oldin qarama-qarshi tomonga kichik balandlik belgisini qo'ying. Rasm ta'rifni mahkamlaydi.

examples.promptEn: In a 3-4-5 right triangle, what is the sine of the angle opposite the side of length 3?
examples.promptUz: 3-4-5 to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda uzunligi 3 bo'lgan tomon qarshisidagi burchakning sinusi necha?

steps.en: Opposite that angle, the side is 3. The hypotenuse is 5.
steps.uz: O'sha burchakning qarshisida tomon 3. Gipotenuza 5.

steps.en: Sine is opposite over hypotenuse.
steps.uz: Sinus — qarama-qarshi bo'lingan gipotenuza.

steps.en: So the sine of that angle is the fraction 3/5.
steps.uz: Demak o'sha burchakning sinusi 3/5 kasri.

examples.promptEn: A ramp rises 3 meters over a horizontal distance of 4 meters. What is the tangent of the angle the ramp makes with the ground?
examples.promptUz: Pandus 4 metr gorizontal masofada 3 metr ko'tariladi. Pandus yer bilan yasagan burchakning tangensi necha?
examples.gloss: ramp — pandus; rises — ko'tariladi; horizontal — gorizontal; tangent — tangens

steps.en: The rise, 3, is opposite the angle with the ground. The horizontal 4 is adjacent.
steps.uz: Ko'tarilish 3 — yer bilan burchakning qarama-qarshisi. Gorizontal 4 — yondosh.

steps.en: Tangent is opposite over adjacent, so tan = 3/4.
steps.uz: Tangens — qarama-qarshi bo'lingan yondosh, demak tan = 3/4.

steps.en: A is the sine, using the hypotenuse 5. B is the cosine. D swaps opposite and adjacent.
steps.uz: A — sinus, gipotenuza 5 ishlatilgan. B — kosinus. D qarama-qarshi va yondoshni almashtiradi.

mistakes.en: Using the hypotenuse as the adjacent side. The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle. For an acute angle it is the denominator of sine and of cosine, never the adjacent leg.
mistakes.uz: Gipotenuzani yondosh tomon deb olish. Gipotenuza to'g'ri burchakning qarshisida. O'tkir burchak uchun u sinus va kosinusning maxraji, hech qachon yondosh katet emas.

mistakes.en: Swapping sine and cosine. Sine uses the opposite leg. Cosine uses the adjacent leg. If you change angles, you must swap them.
mistakes.uz: Sinus va kosinusni almashtirish. Sinus qarama-qarshi katetni oladi. Kosinus yondosh katetni oladi. Burchakni o'zgartirsangiz, ularni almashtirishingiz kerak.

mistakes.en: Writing tan = opposite / hypotenuse. That fraction is sine. Tangent does not use the hypotenuse. It is opposite over adjacent.
mistakes.uz: tan = qarama-qarshi / gipotenuza deb yozish. O'sha kasr — sinus. Tangens gipotenuzani ishlatmaydi. U qarama-qarshi bo'lingan yondosh.

lessons.goalEn: Choose the area formula that matches the figure, including a triangle, a circle, and a trapezoid.
lessons.goalUz: Shaklga mos yuza formulasini tanlash: uchburchak, aylana va trapetsiya, balandlikni qiyshiq tomondan ajratgan holda.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can multiply fractions, including 1/2, and can use π as a symbol rather than a rounded decimal.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar 1/2 ni ham qo'shib kasrlarni ko'paytira oladi va π ni yaxlitlangan o'nli kasr o'rniga belgi sifatida ishlata oladi.

teacherEn.text: Give the triangle formula as half a rectangle. Draw the rectangle around a triangle of base 10 and height 6, and cut it in half to see 30. Then do one circle so π stays in the answer.
Yuza — tekislikdagi joy. Uchburchak — asos marta balandlikning yarmi. Aylana — π marta radius kvadrati. Diametrni radius deb ishlatmang. Balandlik tomonga perpendikulyar, qiyshiq tomonning o'zi emas.
Leave answers in terms of π when the question does. 9π is finished. 28.26 is a different and usually worse answer.

teacherUz.text: Uchburchak formulasini to'rtburchakning yarmi deb bering. Asosi 10, balandligi 6 bo'lgan uchburchak atrofida to'rtburchak chizing va 30 ni ko'rish uchun yarmiga bo'ling. So'ng bitta aylana qiling, π javobda qolsin.
Yuza — tekislikdagi joy. Uchburchak — asos marta balandlikning yarmi. Aylana — π marta radius kvadrati. Diametrni radius deb ishlatmang. Balandlik tomonga perpendikulyar, qiyshiq tomonning o'zi emas.
Savol shunday desa, javobni π orqali qoldiring. 9π tugagan. 28.26 odatda yomonroq boshqa javob.

explainEn.text: Area measures the region a flat figure covers. A rectangle is length times width. A parallelogram is base times the perpendicular height, not times the slanted side. A triangle is half of that: (1/2) × base × height. A base of 10 and a height of 6 give area 30. A right triangle with legs 6 and 8 has area (1/2) × 6 × 8 = 24. The hypotenuse is not needed for the area.

A trapezoid has one pair of parallel sides, the two bases. Its area is the average of the bases times the height: ((b1 + b2)/2) × h. Bases 4 and 10 with height 3 give (14/2) × 3 = 21. A circle of radius r has area πr² and circumference 2πr. Radius 3 gives area 9π. If you are given the diameter, halve it before you square. Diameter 10 means radius 5, and area 25π, not 100π.
triangle (1/2)bh,   circle πr²,   trapezoid ((b1 + b2)/2)h

These formulas are on the reference sheet. The question is which length is the height. Height is perpendicular to the base. A leaning side is not the height unless the figure says it is perpendicular. The SAT asks for the area, or for a shaded region that is a big shape minus a small one. Compute both areas and subtract. Keep π in the answer when it is there.

The traps are forgetting the 1/2 on a triangle, using the diameter as the radius, and multiplying the slanted side instead of the height. Units of area are square units. If the lengths are in centimeters, the area is in square centimeters.
Area formulas live on the reference sheet, but the diagram decides which length is the base and which is the height. Height is perpendicular to the base you chose — not just 'the tall side.'
Composite shapes split into rectangles, triangles, and circles you already know. Draw the split lines; do not invent a new formula for an L-shape.
Write the name of the formula you will use before the numbers. Naming the tool prevents grabbing the wrong one.

explainUz.text: Yuza tekis shakl qoplagan joyni o'lchaydi. To'g'ri to'rtburchak — uzunlik marta en. Parallelogramm — asos marta perpendikulyar balandlik, qiyshiq tomonga emas. Uchburchak uning yarmi: (1/2) × asos × balandlik. Asos 10 va balandlik 6 yuza 30 beradi. Katetlari 6 va 8 bo'lgan to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning yuzi (1/2) × 6 × 8 = 24. Yuza uchun gipotenuza kerak emas.

Trapetsiyaning bir juft tomoni parallel, ikki asos. Yuzi — asoslar o'rtachasi marta balandlik: ((b1 + b2)/2) × h. Asoslar 4 va 10, balandlik 3: (14/2) × 3 = 21. Radiusi r bo'lgan aylananing yuzi πr² va uzunligi 2πr. Radius 3 yuza 9π beradi. Diametr berilsa, kvadratga olishdan oldin yarmiga bo'ling. Diametr 10 degani radius 5 va yuza 25π, 100π emas.
uchburchak (1/2)bh,   aylana πr²,   trapetsiya ((b1 + b2)/2)h

Bu formulalar varaqada. Savol — qaysi uzunlik balandlik. Balandlik asosga perpendikulyar. Qiyshiq tomon balandlik emas, rasm perpendikulyar desa. SAT yuzani yoki katta shakldan kichigi ayirilgan bo'yalgan joyni so'raydi. Ikkala yuzani hisoblang va ayiring. π bor bo'lsa, javobda qoldiring.

Tuzoqlar — uchburchakda 1/2 ni unutish, diametrni radius qilib olish va balandlik o'rniga qiyshiq tomonni ko'paytirish. Yuza birligi kvadrat birlik. Uzunliklar santimetrda bo'lsa, yuza kvadrat santimetrda.
Yuza formulalari varaqada, lekin diagramma qaysi uzunlik asos va qaysi balandlik ekanini hal qiladi. Balandlik tanlagan asosga perpendikulyar — shunchaki 'uzun tomon' emas.
Murakkab shakllar allaqachon bilgan to'rtburchak, uchburchak va aylanalarga bo'linadi. Bo'lish chiziqlarini chizing; L-shakl uchun yangi formula o'ylab topmang.
Sonlardan oldin ishlatadigan formula nomini yozing. Asbobni nomlash noto'g'risini olishni to'sadi.

examples.promptEn: A triangle has base 10 and height 6. What is its area?
examples.promptUz: Uchburchakning asosi 10 va balandligi 6. Yuzi necha?
examples.gloss: base — asos; height — balandlik; area — yuza

steps.en: Triangle area is (1/2) × base × height.
steps.uz: Uchburchak yuzi (1/2) × asos × balandlik.

steps.en: The area of the triangle is 30 square units.
steps.uz: Uchburchakning yuzi 30 kvadrat birlik.

examples.promptEn: A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is its area?
examples.promptUz: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari 6 va 8. Yuzi necha?

steps.en: The legs are the base and the height, because they meet at a right angle.
steps.uz: Katetlar asos va balandlik, chunki ular to'g'ri burchakda uchrashadi.

steps.en: B forgets the 1/2. C is the hypotenuse. D is the sum of the legs. The area does not need the hypotenuse.
steps.uz: B 1/2 ni unutadi. C — gipotenuza. D — katetlar yig'indisi. Yuzaga gipotenuza kerak emas.

mistakes.en: Forgetting the 1/2 in the triangle formula. Base 10 and height 6 make a rectangle of 60 and a triangle of 30. The triangle is the half.
mistakes.uz: Uchburchak formulasida 1/2 ni unutish. Asos 10 va balandlik 6 to'rtburchakni 60, uchburchakni 30 qiladi. Uchburchak — yarim.

mistakes.en: Using the diameter as the radius. A diameter of 10 means r = 5 and area 25π. Squaring 10 gives four times the correct area.
mistakes.uz: Diametrni radius qilib olish. Diametr 10 degani r = 5 va yuza 25π. 10 ni kvadratga olish to'g'ri yuzadan to'rt baravar katta.

mistakes.en: Using a slanted side as the height. Height meets the base at a right angle. If the figure labels a leaning side, that label is not automatically the height.
mistakes.uz: Qiyshiq tomonni balandlik qilib olish. Balandlik asosni to'g'ri burchakda kesadi. Rasm qiyshiq tomonni belgilasa, u belgi avtomatik balandlik emas.

lessons.goalEn: Use the volume formulas for a box, a cylinder, a cone, and a sphere, and compare a cone with a cylinder of the same base and height.
lessons.goalUz: Quti, silindr, konus va shar hajmi formulalaridan foydalanish va konusni xuddi shu asos va balandlikdagi silindr bilan solishtirish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can find the area of a circle and can multiply by a height, including the factor 1/3.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar aylana yuzini topa oladi va balandlikka, 1/3 ko'paytuvchini ham qo'shib, ko'paytira oladi.

teacherEn.text: Build a box of 3 by 4 by 5 with words before formulas: how many unit cubes. Then say a cylinder is a stack of circles, so the volume is the circle's area times the height.

Hajm — jism egallagan joy. Quti — uzunlik marta en marta balandlik. Silindr — asos yuzi marta balandlik. Konus — xuddi shu silindrning uchdan biri. Shar — (4/3)πr³. Varaqada bor. Qaysi shakl ekanini tanlang.
The comparison cone versus cylinder is the SAT move. Same radius, same height, the cone is one third.

teacherUz.text: Formuladan oldin 3 ga 4 ga 5 qutini so'z bilan quring: nechta birlik kub. So'ng ayting: silindr — aylanalar to'plami, demak hajm aylana yuzi marta balandlik.

Hajm — jism egallagan joy. Quti — uzunlik marta en marta balandlik. Silindr — asos yuzi marta balandlik. Konus — xuddi shu silindrning uchdan biri. Shar — (4/3)πr³. Varaqada bor. Qaysi shakl ekanini tanlang.
Konusni silindr bilan solishtirish — SAT yurishi. Radius bir xil, balandlik bir xil, konus uchdan bir.

explainEn.text: Volume measures the space a solid fills. A rectangular box is length × width × height. A 3 by 4 by 5 box has volume 60. A cube of side 4 has volume 4³ = 64. Units are cubic: cubic centimeters if the edges are centimeters.

A cylinder is a stack of equal circles. Its volume is the base area times the height, πr²h. Radius 2 and height 5 give 20π. A cone with the same radius and the same height has one third of that volume, (1/3)πr²h. Radius 3 and height 10 give a cylinder of 90π and a cone of 30π. A sphere is (4/3)πr³. Radius 3 gives (4/3)π × 27 = 36π. A pyramid is one third of the box with the same base area and height.
box ℓwh,  cylinder πr²h,  cone (1/3)πr²h,  sphere (4/3)πr³

These are on the reference sheet. The test is whether you pick the cone's 1/3 when the solid comes to a point, and whether you square the radius before multiplying by the height. A hemisphere is half a sphere, so half of (4/3)πr³, which is (2/3)πr³. Read 'hemisphere' if it appears.

The traps are forgetting the 1/3, using the diameter, and giving a numeric approximation when the exact multiple of π was available. 30π is the answer. 94.2 is a detour. If the solid comes to a point, look for the one-third before you multiply.
Volume formulas also sit on the sheet. Prisms and cylinders are base area times height; pyramids and cones take one-third of that. Spheres use (4/3)πr³ — radius, not diameter, unless you convert.
Units of volume are cubed. A stem that mixes cm and m needs a conversion before you cube a length.
Circle whether the solid is prism-like or pyramid-like before you reach for 1/3. That binary choice is most of the item.

explainUz.text: Hajm jism to'ldirgan joyni o'lchaydi. To'g'ri burchakli quti — uzunlik × en × balandlik. 3 ga 4 ga 5 qutining hajmi 60. Tomoni 4 bo'lgan kubning hajmi 4³ = 64. Birlik kub: qirralar santimetr bo'lsa, kub santimetr.

Silindr — teng aylanlar to'plami. Hajmi asos yuzi marta balandlik, πr²h. Radius 2 va balandlik 5 hajm 20π beradi. Xuddi shu radius va balandlikdagi konusning hajmi uning uchdan biri, (1/3)πr²h. Radius 3 va balandlik 10 silindrni 90π, konusni 30π qiladi. Shar — (4/3)πr³. Radius 3 hajm (4/3)π × 27 = 36π beradi. Piramida — xuddi shu asos yuzi va balandlikdagi qutining uchdan biri.
quti ℓwh,  silindr πr²h,  konus (1/3)πr²h,  shar (4/3)πr³

Bular varaqada. Imtihon — jism uchiga kelganda konusning 1/3 ini olishingiz va balandlikka ko'paytirishdan oldin radiusni kvadratga olishingiz. Yarim shar — sharning yarmi, demak (4/3)πr³ ning yarmi, ya'ni (2/3)πr³. 'Hemisphere' chiqsa, o'qing.

Tuzoqlar — 1/3 ni unutish, diametrni ishlatish va π ning aniq karralisi bor ekan, sonli yaqinlashish berish. 30π — javob. 94.2 — aylanma yo'l. Jism uchiga kelsa, ko'paytirishdan oldin uchdan birni qidiring.
Hajm formulalari ham varaqada. Prisma va silindr — asos yuzasi × balandlik; piramida va konus — shuning uchdan biri. Sfera — (4/3)πr³; diametr emas, radius (aylantirmasangiz).
Hajm birliklari kubda. sm va m aralashgan savolda uzunlikni kubga olishdan oldin aylantirish kerak.
1/3 ga qo'l uzatishdan oldin jism prisma tipimi yoki piramida tipimi aylana qiling. Shu ikkilik tanlov — savolning ko'p qismi.

examples.promptUz: To'g'ri burchakli quti 3 ga 4 ga 5. Hajmi necha?
examples.gloss: volume — hajm; rectangular box — to'g'ri burchakli quti

steps.en: Volume is length × width × height.
steps.uz: Hajm — uzunlik × en × balandlik.

steps.en: The volume of the box is 60 cubic units.
steps.uz: Qutining hajmi 60 kub birlik.

examples.promptEn: A cone has radius 3 and height 10. What is its volume?
examples.promptUz: Konusning radiusi 3 va balandligi 10. Hajmi necha?
examples.gloss: cone — konus; radius — radius; height — balandlik

steps.en: The matching cylinder would have volume πr²h = π × 9 × 10 = 90π.
steps.uz: Mos silindrning hajmi πr²h = π × 9 × 10 = 90π bo'lardi.

steps.en: A cone is one third of that cylinder: (1/3) × 90π = 30π.
steps.uz: Konus o'sha silindrning uchdan biri: (1/3) × 90π = 30π.

steps.en: B is the cylinder, missing the 1/3. C squares something other than the radius or skips the third. The volume is 30π.
steps.uz: B — silindr, 1/3 yo'q. C radiusdan boshqa narsani kvadratga oladi yoki uchdan birni tashlaydi. Hajm 30π.

mistakes.en: Forgetting the 1/3 on a cone or a pyramid. Same base and same height: the pointed solid is one third of the prism or cylinder, not equal to it.
mistakes.uz: Konus yoki piramidada 1/3 ni unutish. Asos bir xil, balandlik bir xil: uchli jism prizma yoki silindrning uchdan biri, unga teng emas.

mistakes.en: Forgetting to square the radius. πr²h uses r². Radius 3 contributes 9, not 3. Then multiply by the height.
mistakes.uz: Radiusni kvadratga olishni unutish. πr²h da r² bor. Radius 3 soni 9 beradi, 3 emas. So'ng balandlikka ko'paytiring.

mistakes.en: Replacing π with 3.14 when the choices are multiples of π. 30π is exact. A decimal is a rounding, and it can miss the choice.
mistakes.uz: Variantlar π ning karralisi bo'lganda π ni 3.14 bilan almashtirish. 30π aniq. O'nli kasr yaxlitlash va u variantni qo'ldan chiqarishi mumkin.

lessons.goalEn: Find an arc length and a sector area as fractions of the whole circle, and read the center and radius from a circle equation.
lessons.goalUz: Yoy uzunligi va sektor yuzini butun aylananing kasri deb topish hamda aylana tenglamasidan markaz va radiusni o'qish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can find a fraction of a number, including a fraction of 360, and can expand (x − h)².
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar sonning kasrini, 360 ning kasrini ham, topa oladi va (x − h)² ni yoya oladi.

teacherEn.text: Draw the circle in the figure: center O, two radii, a 72° wedge. Ask what fraction of the circle 72° is before any formula. 72/360 = 1/5. Then the arc is one fifth of the circumference and the sector is one fifth of the area.
Markaziy burchak — butunning kasri, burchak bo'lingan 360. Yoy — o'sha kasr marta aylana uzunligi. Sektor — o'sha kasr marta yuza. Tenglamada markaz (h, k), radius esa kvadrat ildiz.
Read (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 16 as center (2, −1) and radius 4. The plus inside the second square is a minus of a negative.

teacherUz.text: Rasmdagi aylanani chizing: markaz O, ikki radius, 72° lik bo'lak. Formuladan oldin 72° aylananing qanday kasri ekanini so'rang. 72/360 = 1/5. So'ng yoy aylana uzunligining beshdan biri va sektor yuza ning beshdan biri.
Markaziy burchak — butunning kasri, burchak bo'lingan 360. Yoy — o'sha kasr marta aylana uzunligi. Sektor — o'sha kasr marta yuza. Tenglamada markaz (h, k), radius esa kvadrat ildiz.
(x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 16 ni markaz (2, −1) va radius 4 deb o'qing. Ikkinchi kvadrat ichidagi plus — manfiyning minusi.

explainEn.text: A full circle is 360°. A central angle of 72° is 72/360 = 1/5 of the circle. The arc length is that fraction of the circumference. For radius 5, the circumference is 10π, and the arc is (1/5) × 10π = 2π. The sector, the pie slice, has area equal to that same fraction of πr². A 90° sector of a circle with radius 6 is 90/360 = 1/4 of the area, and (1/4) × 36π = 9π.
arc = (θ/360) × 2πr
sector = (θ/360) × πr²

The equation (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² is a circle with center (h, k) and radius r. (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 16 has center (2, −1), because y + 1 = y − (−1), and radius 4, because 16 = 4². The radius is the square root of the right side, not the right side itself. A student who says the radius is 16 has not taken the root.

The SAT asks for the arc, the sector, the center, or the radius. Sometimes it gives the arc length and asks for the angle: fraction = arc / circumference, then multiply by 360. An arc of 4π on a circle of radius 6 is 4π / 12π = 1/3 of the circle, so the angle is 120°. The traps are using the diameter in the circumference, forgetting to take the square root of r², and reading y + 1 as a center with y-coordinate +1. Say the fraction of 360 out loud before you touch π.
Circle equations (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² center at (h, k) with radius r. Arc length and sector area are fractions of the full circle given by the central angle over 360° (or 2π radians).
arc = (θ/360)·2πr ·  sector = (θ/360)·πr²
Convert the angle to a fraction of the circle before multiplying. Students who multiply by the angle in degrees invent nonsense units.
When the stem gives a diameter, halve it before any area or arc formula. Using the diameter as if it were r doubles lengths and quadruples areas.

explainUz.text: To'liq aylana 360°. 72° lik markaziy burchak aylananing 72/360 = 1/5 qismi. Yoy uzunligi aylana uzunligining o'sha kasri. Radius 5 bo'lsa, aylana uzunligi 10π va yoy (1/5) × 10π = 2π. Sektor, pirog bo'lagi, yuzi πr² ning o'sha kasriga teng. Radiusi 6 bo'lgan aylananing 90° lik sektori yuzaning 90/360 = 1/4 qismi va (1/4) × 36π = 9π.
yoy = (θ/360) × 2πr
sektor = (θ/360) × πr²

(x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² tenglamasi — markazi (h, k) va radiusi r bo'lgan aylana. (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 16 ning markazi (2, −1), chunki y + 1 = y − (−1), va radiusi 4, chunki 16 = 4². Radius — o'ng tomonning kvadrat ildizi, o'ng tomonning o'zi emas. Radius 16 degan o'quvchi ildizni olmagan.

SAT yoyni, sektorni, markazni yoki radiusni so'raydi. Ba'zan yoy uzunligini berib, burchakni so'raydi: kasr = yoy / aylana uzunligi, so'ng 360 ga ko'paytiring. Radiusi 6 bo'lgan aylanada 4π yoy aylananing 4π / 12π = 1/3 qismi, demak burchak 120°. Tuzoqlar — aylana uzunligida diametrni ishlatish, r² ning ildizini olmaslik va y + 1 ni y koordinatasi +1 bo'lgan markaz deb o'qish. π ga tegishdan oldin 360 ning kasrini ovoz chiqarib ayting.
Aylana tenglamasi (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² markaz (h, k), radius r. Yoy uzunligi va sektor yuzasi to'liq aylananing markaziy burchak / 360° (yoki 2π radian) kasridir.
yoy = (θ/360)·2πr ·  sektor = (θ/360)·πr²
Ko'paytirishdan oldin burchakni aylana kasriga aylantiring. Gradusdagi burchakka to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'paytirgan o'quvchi bema'ni birlik yasaydi.
Savol diametr bersa, yuza yoki yoy formulasidan oldin uni ikkiga bo'ling. Diametrni r o'rniga ishlatish uzunlikni ikki, yuzani to'rt baravar qiladi.

examples.promptEn: A circle has radius 5. What is the length of an arc with central angle 72°?
examples.promptUz: Aylananing radiusi 5. Markaziy burchagi 72° bo'lgan yoyning uzunligi necha?
examples.gloss: arc — yoy; central angle — markaziy burchak

steps.en: The fraction of the circle is 72/360 = 1/5.
steps.uz: Aylananing kasri 72/360 = 1/5.

steps.en: The circumference is 2π × 5 = 10π.
steps.uz: Aylana uzunligi 2π × 5 = 10π.

steps.en: One fifth of the circumference is (1/5) × 10π = 2π.
steps.uz: Aylana uzunligining beshdan biri (1/5) × 10π = 2π.

examples.promptEn: A sector of a circle has radius 6 and central angle 90°. What is the area of the sector?
examples.promptUz: Aylana sektorining radiusi 6 va markaziy burchagi 90°. Sektor yuzi necha?

steps.en: 90/360 = 1/4 of the circle.
steps.uz: 90/360 = aylananing 1/4 qismi.

steps.en: The full area is π × 6² = 36π. The sector is (1/4) × 36π = 9π.
steps.uz: To'liq yuza π × 6² = 36π. Sektor (1/4) × 36π = 9π.

steps.en: B is the whole circle. D is half. C uses the radius without squaring, or a different fraction. The sector is 9π.
steps.uz: B — butun aylana. D — yarim. C radiusni kvadratga olmasdan yoki boshqa kasr bilan ishlatadi. Sektor 9π.

mistakes.en: Using 72/100 or 72/180 as the fraction of the circle. A full turn is 360°. 72/360 = 1/5.
mistakes.uz: Aylananing kasri sifatida 72/100 yoki 72/180 ni olish. To'liq aylanish 360°. 72/360 = 1/5.

mistakes.en: Reading the radius as the number on the right side of the equation. In (x − h)² + (y − k)² = 16, the radius is 4, because 4² = 16.
mistakes.uz: Radiusni tenglama o'ng tomonidagi son deb o'qish. (x − h)² + (y − k)² = 16 da radius 4, chunki 4² = 16.

mistakes.en: Reading y + 1 as a center coordinate of +1. y + 1 = y − (−1), so the y-coordinate of the center is −1.
mistakes.uz: y + 1 ni markaz koordinatasi +1 deb o'qish. y + 1 = y − (−1), demak markazning y koordinatasi −1.

introEn.text: Four lessons on the shape of the section, the English of the stems, when the hand is the right tool and when Desmos is, and the error log. These lessons assume the content is underway. They do not replace it.

introUz.text: To'rt dars: bo'limning shakli, savol iboralarining inglizchasi, qo'l qachon to'g'ri qurol va Desmos qachon, hamda xato daftari. Bu darslar mazmun ketayotganini taxmin qiladi. Ular mazmunning o'rnini bosmaydi.

lessons.titleEn: How the math section is built
lessons.goalEn: Know the two modules, the clock, and the fact that a blank answer cannot score, so the class can plan a paper before the content gets hard.
lessons.goalUz: Ikki modulni, vaqtni va bo'sh javob ball olmasligini bilish, mazmun qiyinlashishidan oldin sinf varaqani rejalashtira olsin.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can divide 70 by 2 and can multiply 22 by 2. The content lessons can still be in progress.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar 70 ni 2 ga bo'la oladi va 22 ni 2 ga ko'paytira oladi. Mazmun darslari hali davom etayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.

teacherEn.text: Draw two boxes on the board, 22 questions and 35 minutes each. Ask how many seconds a question gets if the time is shared evenly, then refuse the fake precision. The point is the size of the section, not a stopwatch.
Ikki modul, har birida 22 savol va taxminan 35 daqiqa. Jami 44 savol, 70 daqiqa. Kalkulyator hammada ruxsat. Noto'g'ri javob uchun alohida jarima yo'q. Bo'sh qoldirish yordam bermaydi.
Tell them Module 2 gets harder if Module 1 went well. Do not invent a scaled-score formula. Accuracy on the first module is the lever you can actually teach.

teacherUz.text: Doskaga ikkita quti chizing, har birida 22 savol va 35 daqiqa. Vaqt teng bo'linsa bitta savolga necha soniya tegishini so'rang, so'ng soxta aniqlikni rad eting. Gap bo'limning o'lchami haqida, sekundomer haqida emas.
Ikki modul, har birida 22 savol va taxminan 35 daqiqa. Jami 44 savol, 70 daqiqa. Kalkulyator hammada ruxsat. Noto'g'ri javob uchun alohida jarima yo'q. Bo'sh qoldirish yordam bermaydi.
Ayting: birinchi modul yaxshi o'tsa, ikkinchisi qiyinlashadi. Scaled ball formulasini o'ylab topmang. Birinchi moduldagi aniqlik — haqiqatan o'rgata oladigan richag.

explainEn.text: Digital SAT Math is two modules. Each module has 22 questions and 35 minutes. Together that is 44 questions and 70 minutes. The Desmos calculator is allowed on every math question. There is no separate non-calculator section. About three quarters of the questions are four-choice. The rest ask the student to produce the number. This book does not convert a raw count into a scaled score. That conversion is the test's, and it is not a classroom formula.

Module 2 is adaptive. A stronger Module 1 leads to a harder Module 2. A harder second module is a sign the first module went well. It is not a punishment, and it is not a reason to rush the first module into careless errors. The first module is where accuracy buys the harder, higher-ceiling second module.

There is no guessing penalty. A wrong answer and a blank answer are not the same kind of object: a blank cannot become correct, and a guess might. Leave nothing blank in the last minute. Before that, do not spend six minutes on one question while five easier ones wait. Every question in a module has the same job: be answered. The content difficulty changes. The scoring unit the student can see does not come with a public weight list.

A usable pace is about a minute and a half for a question, with a few questions finished faster so the long ones have room. 15 minutes for 10 remaining questions is 1.5 minutes each. If a question is not moving after about two minutes, mark it, guess if the module is ending, and move. The reference sheet will not tell you the slope, the percent change, or the meaning of f(4). Those live in the earlier lessons.

The Digital SAT Math section is two equal modules with a short break structure built into the adaptive design. Timing is a resource: easy points first, marked skips second, stubborn algebra last inside a module.
Desmos is available; it does not replace reading. A perfect graph of the wrong equation scores zero. Use the grid to check, not to avoid thinking.
After a practice module, ask only one timing question: where did the clock actually hurt? Fix that slice next, not 'everything.'

explainUz.text: Raqamli SAT Math — ikki modul. Har modulda 22 savol va 35 daqiqa. Birga 44 savol va 70 daqiqa. Desmos kalkulyatori har bir math savolida ruxsat. Alohida kalkulyatorsiz bo'lim yo'q. Savollarning taxminan to'rtdan uchi to'rt variantli. Qolganida o'quvchi sonning o'zini yozadi. Bu kitob raw sonni scaled ballga aylantirmaydi. O'sha aylantirish imtihonniki va u sinf formulasi emas.

Ikkinchi modul moslashuvchan. Kuchliroq birinchi modul qiyinroq ikkinchi modulga olib boradi. Qiyinroq ikkinchi modul — birinchisi yaxshi o'tganining belgisi. U jazo emas va birinchi modulni shoshqaloq xatolarga yugurtirish uchun sabab emas. Birinchi modul — aniqlik qiyinroq, shipi balandroq ikkinchi modulni sotib oladigan joy.

Taxmin uchun jarima yo'q. Noto'g'ri javob va bo'sh javob bir xil narsa emas: bo'sh joy to'g'ri bo'lib qololmaydi, taxmin esa ba'zan tegadi. Oxirgi daqiqada hech narsani bo'sh qoldirmang. Undan oldin beshta oson savol kutib turganda bitta savolga olti daqiqa sarflamang. Moduldagi har bir savolning ishi — javob olish. Mazmun qiyinligi o'zgaradi. O'quvchi ko'ra oladigan ball birligi ommaviy og'irlik ro'yxati bilan kelmaydi.

Yaroqli sur'at — savolga taxminan bir yarim daqiqa, bir nechtasi tezroq tugashi uchun uzunlariga joy qolsin. Qolgan 10 savolga 15 daqiqa — har biriga 1.5 daqiqa. Savol taxminan ikki daqiqadan keyin siljimasa, belgilang, modul tugayotgan bo'lsa taxmin qiling va o'ting. Formula varaqasi qiyalikni, foiz o'zgarishini yoki f(4) ning ma'nosini aytmaydi. Ular oldingi darslarda yashaydi.
Raqamli SAT Math bo'limi — adaptive tuzilmadagi ikki teng modul. Vaqt — resurs: avval oson ochkolar, keyin belgilangan o'tkazishlar, modul ichida qaysar algebra oxirida.
Desmos bor; u o'qishning o'rnini bosmaydi. Noto'g'ri tenglamarning mukammal grafigi nol beradi. To'rni tekshirish uchun ishlating, o'ylashdan qochish uchun emas.
Mashq modulidan keyin faqat bitta vaqt savolini bering: soat qayerda haqiqatan og'ritdi? Keyin 'hammasini' emas, o'sha bo'lakni tuzating.

examples.promptEn: The math section is 70 minutes and has two modules of equal length. How many minutes is one module?
examples.promptUz: Math bo'limi 70 daqiqa va uzunligi teng ikki moduldan iborat. Bitta modul necha daqiqa?

steps.en: The two modules split the 70 minutes equally.
steps.uz: Ikki modul 70 daqiqani teng bo'ladi.

steps.en: Divide the section in half: 70 / 2 = 35.
steps.uz: Bo'limni teng ikkiga bo'ling: 70 / 2 = 35.

steps.en: One module is 35 minutes, and it holds 22 questions.
steps.uz: Bitta modul 35 daqiqa va unda 22 savol bor.

examples.promptEn: A student has 15 minutes left and 10 questions left. If the time is shared equally, how many minutes is that per question?
examples.promptUz: O'quvchida 15 daqiqa va 10 ta savol qolgan. Vaqt teng bo'linsa, bitta savolga necha daqiqa to'g'ri keladi?
examples.gloss: left — qolgan; per question — bitta savolga

steps.en: Share 15 minutes across 10 questions: 15/10.
steps.uz: 15 daqiqani 10 savolga bo'ling: 15/10.

steps.en: 15/10 = 3/2 = 1.5 minutes per question.
steps.uz: 15/10 = 3/2 = savoliga 1.5 daqiqa.

steps.en: A rounds down to a minute and hides the half. C is 15 − 10. D adds them. The equal share is 3/2 minutes.
steps.uz: A yarimni yashirib, daqiqagacha yaxlitlaydi. C — 15 − 10. D ularni qo'shadi. Teng ulush 3/2 daqiqa.

mistakes.en: Leaving answers blank because a wrong answer 'hurts.' There is no extra penalty. A blank cannot be correct. A filled answer might be.
mistakes.uz: Noto'g'ri javob 'zarar' qiladi deb javoblarni bo'sh qoldirish. Qo'shimcha jarima yo'q. Bo'sh joy to'g'ri bo'la olmaydi. To'ldirilgan javob bo'lishi mumkin.

mistakes.en: Rushing Module 1 to 'save energy' for Module 2. Careless errors on the first module change which second module you see. Accuracy first, then pace.
mistakes.uz: Ikkinchi modulga 'kuch saqlash' uchun birinchi modulni yugurish. Birinchi moduldagi shoshqaloq xatolar qaysi ikkinchi modulni ko'rishingizni o'zgartiradi. Avval aniqlik, so'ng sur'at.

mistakes.en: Hunting the reference sheet for slope, percent change, or function notation. Those are not on it. The sheet is area, volume, circles, and special triangles.
mistakes.uz: Qiyalik, foiz o'zgarishi yoki funksiya yozuvidan varaqani qidirish. Ular u yerda yo'q. Varaqada yuza, hajm, aylana va maxsus uchburchaklar bor.

practice.promptUz: Bo'lim 70 daqiqa va modullar teng bo'lsa, bitta math modul necha daqiqa?
