lessons.titleEn: The English of a math question
lessons.goalEn: Translate the handful of stems that carry the SAT math section, and do the small piece of math each one asks.
lessons.goalUz: SAT math bo'limini ko'tarib yuradigan bir necha savol iborasini tarjima qilish va har biri so'ragan kichik hisobni bajarish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can solve a linear equation and can simplify an expression. The English is the new layer.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar chiziqli tenglamani yecha oladi va ifodani soddalashtira oladi. Inglizcha — yangi qatlam.

teacherEn.text: Put six phrases on the board and do not start the algebra until the class has said the Uzbek. The phrases are: the value of x, which of the following, equivalent, in terms of, satisfies, no solution.

'The value of x' — x ning o'zi. 'Equivalent' — teng kuchli, bir xil qiymat. 'In terms of y' — javobda y qoladi, x ketadi. 'Satisfies' — sonni qo'yib, tenglik rost chiqadi. 'No solution' — hech qanday son rost qilmaydi.
Then give one tiny equation per phrase so the English is attached to a number they can check.

teacherUz.text: Doskaga olti ibora yozing va sinf o'zbekchasini aytmaguncha algebrani boshlamang. Iboralar: the value of x, which of the following, equivalent, in terms of, satisfies, no solution.

'The value of x' — x ning o'zi. 'Equivalent' — teng kuchli, bir xil qiymat. 'In terms of y' — javobda y qoladi, x ketadi. 'Satisfies' — sonni qo'yib, tenglik rost chiqadi. 'No solution' — hech qanday son rost qilmaydi.
So'ng har bir iboraga bitta kichik tenglama bering, inglizcha ular tekshira oladigan songa yopishsin.

explainEn.text: The math on this test is wrapped in a small set of English sentences. Learning the sentences is as useful as learning another formula. 'What is the value of x?' asks for the number x stands for. 'Which of the following' means one of the four choices, and the others are traps built from real mistakes. 'Equivalent' means the same value in different clothes. You rewrite, you do not pick the one that looks busy.

'In terms of y' means the answer still contains y, and x has been removed. From x + y = 10, x in terms of y is 10 − y. 'Satisfies the equation' means 'makes it true when substituted.' For x + 4 = 7, the value 3 satisfies it because 3 + 4 = 7. The value 2 does not. 'No solution' means the sentence is never true. x + 1 = x + 2 becomes 0 = 1 after you subtract x. Stop and say there is no solution.

Other stems the class will meet: 'how many,' 'the best interpretation,' 'according to the table,' 'according to the graph.' Interpretation questions are not a second mystery. They ask what a slope, an intercept, or a residual means in the story. A slope of 2 dollars per notebook is the cost of one more notebook. The intercept is the fee when the count is zero.

Read the last line twice. It names the noun. A correct equation for the wrong noun is the most expensive English error in this course. Translate the stem into one Uzbek sentence before you compute, for as long as the class still needs the translation. Later, the English can stand alone.
SAT English hides the math target in ordinary nouns: 'how many more,' 'in terms of,' 'which could be,' 'closest to.' Translate the phrase before you touch algebra.
Build a two-column habit: left side the English chunk, right side the math chunk. When the columns disagree, the student guessed.
Make the student point to the exact words that become the equation. If they point at empty air, the stem was never read.

explainUz.text: Bu imtihondagi matematika kichik inglizcha gaplar ichiga o'ralgan. Gaplarni o'rganish yana bitta formulani o'rganishchalik foydali. 'What is the value of x?' x turgan sonni so'raydi. 'Which of the following' to'rt variantdan bittasi degani, qolganlari haqiqiy xatolardan qurilgan tuzoq. 'Equivalent' boshqa kiyimdagi bir xil qiymat degani. Siz qayta yozasiz, band ko'ringanini tanlamaysiz.

'In terms of y' javobda y qoladi va x ketadi degani. x + y = 10 dan y orqali x bu 10 − y. 'Satisfies the equation' 'o'rniga qo'ysangiz, rost bo'ladi' degani. x + 4 = 7 uchun 3 qanoatlantiradi, chunki 3 + 4 = 7. 2 qanoatlantirmaydi. 'No solution' gap hech qachon rost emas degani. x + 1 = x + 2 dan x ni ayirsangiz 0 = 1 chiqadi. To'xtang va yechim yo'q deb ayting.

Sinf yana uchratadigan iboralar: 'how many,' 'the best interpretation,' 'according to the table,' 'according to the graph.' Talqin savollari ikkinchi sir emas. Ular qiyalik, kesishish yoki qoldiq hikoyada nimani anglatishini so'raydi. Daftariga 2 dollar qiyalik — yana bitta daftarning narxi. Kesishish — sanoq nol bo'lgandagi haq.

Oxirgi qatorni ikki marta o'qing. U otni aytadi. Noto'g'ri ot uchun to'g'ri tenglama — shu kursdagi eng qimmat inglizcha xato. Sinf tarjimaga muhtoj ekan, hisoblashdan oldin iborani bitta o'zbekcha gapga aylantiring. Keyinroq inglizcha o'zi tura oladi.
SAT inglizchasi matematik nishonni oddiy otlarda yashiradi: 'how many more,' 'in terms of,' 'which could be,' 'closest to.' Algebraga tegishdan oldin iborani tarjima qiling.
Ikki ustun odati: chapda inglizcha bo'lak, o'ngda matematik bo'lak. Ustunlar mos kelmasa, o'quvchi taxmin qilgan.
O'quvchi tenglamaga aylanadigan aniq so'zlarni ko'rsatsin. Bo'sh havoga ko'rsatasa, savol umuman o'qilmagan.

examples.promptEn: The equation is 2x = 10. What is the value of x?
examples.promptUz: Tenglama 2x = 10. x ning qiymati necha?
examples.gloss: the value of x — x ning qiymati

steps.en: 'The value of x' asks for the number x stands for.
steps.uz: 'The value of x' x turgan sonni so'raydi.

steps.en: Divide both sides by 2: x = 5.
steps.uz: Ikki tomonni 2 ga bo'ling: x = 5.

steps.en: Check: 2 × 5 = 10. The value is 5.
steps.uz: Tekshiruv: 2 × 5 = 10. Qiymat 5.

examples.promptEn: Which value of x satisfies the equation x + 4 = 7?
examples.promptUz: x ning qaysi qiymati x + 4 = 7 tenglamasini qanoatlantiradi?

steps.en: 'Satisfies' means the number makes the equation true.
steps.uz: 'Satisfies' son tenglamani rost qiladi degani.

steps.en: Subtract 4: x = 3. Check: 3 + 4 = 7.
steps.uz: 4 ni ayiring: x = 3. Tekshiruv: 3 + 4 = 7.

steps.en: B is the added 4. C is the right-hand side. D adds them. Only 3 satisfies the equation.
steps.uz: B — qo'shilgan 4. C — o'ng tomon. D ularni qo'shadi. Faqat 3 tenglamani qanoatlantiradi.

mistakes.en: Answering with a number that appears in the stem but is not the value of x. In x + 4 = 7, both 4 and 7 appear. The value of x is 3, the number that was hiding.
mistakes.uz: Matnda turgan, lekin x ning qiymati bo'lmagan son bilan javob berish. x + 4 = 7 da 4 ham, 7 ham turadi. x ning qiymati 3, yashiringan son.

mistakes.en: Reading 'in terms of y' as a request to plug in a number. The answer should still contain y. From x + y = 10, x = 10 − y is finished.
mistakes.uz: 'In terms of y' ni son qo'yish so'rovi deb o'qish. Javobda y qolishi kerak. x + y = 10 dan x = 10 − y tugagan.

mistakes.en: Forcing a solution out of x + 1 = x + 2. Subtracting x leaves 1 = 2, which is never true. The honest answer is no solution.
mistakes.uz: x + 1 = x + 2 dan zo'rlab yechim chiqarish. x ni ayirish 1 = 2 qoldiradi, bu hech qachon rost emas. Halol javob — yechim yo'q.

lessons.goalEn: Solve the idea by hand in class, and know which test-day jobs are faster to type into the built-in calculator.
lessons.goalUz: G'oyani sinfda qo'lda yechish va imtihon kunida qaysi ishlar o'rnatilgan kalkulyatorga yozish tezroq ekanini bilish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students can solve a linear system and can evaluate f(a number). A laptop is useful and not required.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar chiziqli sistemani yecha oladi va f(son) ni hisoblay oladi. Noutbuk foydali va shart emas.

teacherEn.text: Do the intersection by hand first: y = 2x + 1 and y = −x + 7. Get (2, 5). Then, if a screen is available, type both equations and point at the same dot. If no screen is available, write the two lines you would type and stop.
Sinfda qo'l g'oyani ushlaydi. Imtihon kunida Desmos shu g'oyani tekshiradi yoki kesishishni tez chizadi. Qisqa foiz va kasrni kalkulyatorga berib yubormang. Aniq kasr kerak bo'lsa, qo'l tozaroq.

Name three jobs for Desmos: a system intersection, a quick check that two expressions match, and a graph of a parabola's vertex. Name three jobs for the hand: a one-step percent, a sign flip, a fraction in lowest terms.

teacherUz.text: Avval kesishishni qo'lda qiling: y = 2x + 1 va y = −x + 7. (2, 5) ni oling. So'ng ekran bo'lsa, ikkala tenglamani yozing va o'sha nuqtani ko'rsating. Ekran bo'lmasa, yozadigan ikki qatorni yozing va to'xtang.
Sinfda qo'l g'oyani ushlaydi. Imtihon kunida Desmos shu g'oyani tekshiradi yoki kesishishni tez chizadi. Qisqa foiz va kasrni kalkulyatorga berib yubormang. Aniq kasr kerak bo'lsa, qo'l tozaroq.
Desmos uchun uch ishni ayting: sistema kesishishi, ikki ifoda mosligini tez tekshirish va parabola uchini chizish. Qo'l uchun uch ish: bir qadamli foiz, ishora almashtirish, eng kichik hadli kasr.

explainEn.text: Desmos is the calculator built into the digital test. It graphs, it computes, and it can show where two graphs meet. It does not know what the question asked. In class the hand goes first, because the hand is what understands a slope, a flip, or a common denominator. On test day the calculator is a check and, for some pictures, a faster path to a point you could have found by algebra.

A system is the clearest calculator job. Type y = 2x + 1 and y = −x + 7. The lines meet at (2, 5). By hand, set 2x + 1 = −x + 7, so 3x = 6, x = 2, and y = 5. If the screen and the hand disagree, the hand's algebra is the one to recheck, and so is a mistyped sign on the screen. Do not trust either without a reason.

Equivalent expressions can be checked by graphing both, or by subtracting them and seeing 0. That check is a safety net after you have rewritten. It is a poor way to learn the rewrite. A percent such as 15% of 80 is (15/100) × 80 = 12, and typing 0.15 × 80 is fine once the meaning is secure. A negative exponent, a flipped inequality, and a fraction in lowest terms are still hand work. The calculator will happily give a decimal for 7/12. The test is often happier with 7/12.

Use Desmos when a graph is the object: an intersection, a vertex you want to see, a line of fit you were given as an equation. Use the hand when the object is a reason: why the sign flips, why the second 20% is not the undo of the first, why x = −1 failed the radical. A student who can only tap has nothing to tap when the screen is the wrong tool.
Hand work builds the model; Desmos checks or solves the graph you already named. Entering a cloud of points without an equation is not a strategy — it is hope.
Good Desmos habits: one equation per line, zoom until the feature you care about fills the view, use a table when the stem gives discrete inputs.
Require a handwritten equation before the laptop opens. The hand commits; the screen verifies.

explainUz.text: Desmos — raqamli imtihonga o'rnatilgan kalkulyator. U grafik chizadi, hisoblaydi va ikki grafik qayerda uchrashishini ko'rsata oladi. U savol nima so'raganini bilmaydi. Sinfda avval qo'l, chunki qiyalikni, almashtirishni yoki umumiy maxrajni tushunadigan qo'l. Imtihon kunida kalkulyator — tekshiruv va ba'zi rasmlarda algebra topa oladigan nuqtaga tezroq yo'l.

Sistema — eng ravshan kalkulyator ishi. y = 2x + 1 va y = −x + 7 ni yozing. Chiziqlar (2, 5) da uchrashadi. Qo'lda 2x + 1 = −x + 7, demak 3x = 6, x = 2 va y = 5. Ekran va qo'l kelishmasa, qo'ldagi algebrani ham, ekrandagi noto'g'ri ishorani ham qayta tekshiring. Sababsiz birortasiga ishonmang.

Teng kuchli ifodalarni ikkalasini chizib yoki ayirmani 0 ko'rib tekshirish mumkin. Bu tekshiruv qayta yozishdan keyingi xavfsizlik to'ri. U qayta yozishni o'rganishning yomon yo'li. 80 ning 15 foizi (15/100) × 80 = 12, ma'no mustahkam bo'lsa 0.15 × 80 ni yozish joiz. Manfiy daraja, almashtirilgan tengsizlik va eng kichik hadli kasr hali qo'l ishi. Kalkulyator 7/12 uchun xursand o'nli kasr beradi. Imtihon ko'pincha 7/12 ni afzal ko'radi.

Grafik obyekt bo'lsa, Desmos ishlating: kesishish, ko'rmoqchi bo'lgan uch, tenglama berilgan mos chiziq. Obyekt sabab bo'lsa, qo'l ishlating: nima uchun belgi almashtiriladi, nima uchun ikkinchi 20% birinchisini qaytarmaydi, nima uchun x = −1 radikalda yiqildi. Faqat bosa oladigan o'quvchining ekran noto'g'ri qurol bo'lganda bosadigan narsasi qolmaydi.
Qo'l ishi modelni quradi; Desmos siz allaqachon nomlagan grafikni tekshiradi yoki yechadi. Tenglamasiz nuqtalar bulutini kiritish — strategiya emas, umid.
Yaxshi Desmos odati: har qatorda bitta tenglama, sizni qiziqtirgan qism ekranni to'ldirguncha zum qiling, savol diskret kirish bersa jadval ishlating.
Noutbuk ochilishidan oldin qo'lda yozilgan tenglamani talab qiling. Qo'l majburlaydi; ekran tasdiqlaydi.

examples.promptEn: Where do the lines y = 2x + 1 and y = −x + 7 intersect? Give x and y.
examples.promptUz: y = 2x + 1 va y = −x + 7 chiziqlari qayerda kesishadi? x va y ni yozing.

steps.en: Set the right-hand sides equal: 2x + 1 = −x + 7.
steps.uz: O'ng tomonlarni tenglang: 2x + 1 = −x + 7.

steps.en: Add x and subtract 1: 3x = 6, so x = 2. Then y = 2(2) + 1 = 5.
steps.uz: x ni qo'shing va 1 ni ayiring: 3x = 6, demak x = 2. So'ng y = 2(2) + 1 = 5.

steps.en: The intersection is (2, 5). On Desmos, the same two equations meet at that dot.
steps.uz: Kesishish (2, 5). Desmosda o'sha ikki tenglama o'sha nuqtada uchrashadi.

examples.promptEn: What is 18% of 250? Do it as a fraction, the way you would before you type a decimal.
examples.promptUz: 250 ning 18 foizi necha? O'nli kasr yozishdan oldin qilganingizdek, kasr bilan qiling.

steps.en: Write the percent as a fraction first: 18% = 18/100 = 9/50.
steps.uz: Avval foizni kasr qiling: 18% = 18/100 = 9/50.

steps.en: Typing 0.18 × 250 also gives 45, after the fraction meaning is secure. A is the percent. D moves the point too far.
steps.uz: 0.18 × 250 ham 45 beradi, kasr ma'nosi mustahkam bo'lgandan keyin. A — foizning o'zi. D nuqtani haddan tashqari siljitadi.

mistakes.en: Typing before translating. Desmos will graph y = 2x + 1 happily and still not know that the question asked for the intercept. Read the noun, then type.
mistakes.uz: Tarjima qilishdan oldin yozish. Desmos y = 2x + 1 ni xursand chizadi va savol kesishishni so'raganini baribir bilmaydi. Avval otni o'qing, so'ng yozing.

mistakes.en: Accepting a long decimal for a fraction the test wants in lowest terms. 7/12 is the answer. 0.583 is a rounded cousin, and a student-produced grid may want the fraction.
mistakes.uz: Imtihon eng kichik hadlarda xohlagan kasr o'rniga uzun o'nli kasrni qabul qilish. 7/12 — javob. 0.583 — yaxlitlangan qarindosh, va o'quvchi yozadigan katak kasrni xohlashi mumkin.

mistakes.en: Letting the calculator flip an inequality. You still have to flip the sign when you divide by a negative. The screen does not do that reasoning unless you already typed the correct relation.
mistakes.uz: Kalkulyatorga tengsizlikni almashtirishni topshirish. Manfiyga bo'lganda belgini hali ham o'zingiz almashtirasiz. Siz to'g'ri munosabatni yozib qo'ymaguningizcha ekran o'sha mulohazani qilmaydi.

practice.promptEn: Where do y = x + 1 and y = 4 intersect? Give x.
practice.promptUz: y = x + 1 va y = 4 qayerda kesishadi? x ni yozing.

lessons.goalEn: Name the recurring wrong moves, correct each one, and keep a log the next lesson can start from.
lessons.goalUz: Qayta-qayta chiqadigan noto'g'ri yurishlarni nomlash, har birini tuzatish va keyingi dars boshlanadigan daftarni yuritish.
lessons.prereqEn: Students have met percent change, inequality flips, radius versus diameter, and the difference between x and y.
lessons.prereqUz: O'quvchilar foiz o'zgarishi, tengsizlik almashtirishi, radius va diametr farqi hamda x va y farqini ko'rgan.

teacherEn.text: Do not teach a new topic. Put five wrong student lines on the board, one from each trap family, and ask only 'what was the move, and what is the correction?' The correction is a number. The move is a name.
Xato daftari — yangi mavzu emas. Har bir qator: sana, mavzu, men nima qildim, to'g'ri g'oya, qayta sana. Ertangi dars shu daftarning bitta qatoridan boshlanadi.
Photocopy the blank log under this lesson. Six rows are enough for a week.

teacherUz.text: Yangi mavzu o'qitmang. Doskaga har bir tuzoq oilasidan bittadan, beshta noto'g'ri o'quvchi qatorini qo'ying va faqat 'yurish nima edi va tuzatish nima?' deb so'rang. Tuzatish — son. Yurish — nom.
Xato daftari — yangi mavzu emas. Har bir qator: sana, mavzu, men nima qildim, to'g'ri g'oya, qayta sana. Ertangi dars shu daftarning bitta qatoridan boshlanadi.
Shu dars ostidagi bo'sh daftarni nusxa qiling. Haftaga olti qator yetadi.

explainEn.text: The same wrong moves return in new clothes. Naming them is how they stop being surprises. A percent of a number is the number times the percent, not the number divided by the percent. 20% of 50 is 10, not 50/20. An inequality flips only when you multiply or divide by a negative. −2x > 6 becomes x < −3, not x > −3.

A circle's area uses the radius. If the radius is 5, the area is 25π. Using 10 because it was nearby, the diameter, produces 100π, four times too big. A system hands you a pair. If the question asks for y and you found x = 3, y = 4, the answer is 4. Boxing x is a reading error that feels like an algebra error.

Percent change divides by the original. From 50 to 80 the change is 30 and the original is 50, so the increase is 30/50 = 60%. Dividing by the new number, 30/80, gives 37.5% and looks tidy. It answers a different fraction. The original is the denominator in a change question.

The log is a table with five columns: date, topic, what I did, the correct idea, and the date I redo it. One row per mistake, in the student's words plus the correction. The next class starts by redoing one row, not by opening a new definition. A mistake that is redone correctly three days later can leave the active list. A mistake that is only admired stays.

Traps are reusable: wrong noun, unsimplified fraction, sign flip on inequality, canceled terms instead of factors, percent of the new instead of the old. The error log turns a trap into a named enemy.
Each log row needs a date, a topic, what you did, the right idea, and a retest date. Without the retest date, the log is a diary, not a tool.
Start the next lesson with one log row, not a new lecture. Repair beats coverage when the exam is near.

explainUz.text: Bir xil noto'g'ri yurishlar yangi kiyimda qaytadi. Ularni nomlash — ularning kutilmagan bo'lib qolishini to'xtatish. Sonning foizi — son marta foiz, son bo'lingan foiz emas. 50 ning 20 foizi 10, 50/20 emas. Tengsizlik faqat manfiyga ko'paytirganda yoki bo'lganda almashtiriladi. −2x > 6 dan x < −3 chiqadi, x > −3 emas.

Aylana yuzi radiusni ishlatadi. Radius 5 bo'lsa, yuza 25π. Yaqin turgani uchun 10 ni, diametrni ishlatish 100π beradi, to'rt baravar katta. Sistema sizga juft beradi. Savol y ni so'rasa va siz x = 3, y = 4 topgan bo'lsangiz, javob 4. x ni ramkalash algebra xatosidek tuyuladigan o'qish xatosi.

Foiz o'zgarishi eskisiga bo'linadi. 50 dan 80 gacha o'zgarish 30 va eski son 50, demak o'sish 30/50 = 60%. Yangi songa bo'lish, 30/80, 37.5% beradi va tartibli ko'rinadi. U boshqa kasrga javob beradi. O'zgarish savolida maxraj — eski son.

Daftar — besh ustunli jadval: sana, mavzu, men nima qildim, to'g'ri g'oya va qayta qilgan sana. Har bir xato uchun bitta qator, o'quvchining so'zlari va tuzatish. Keyingi dars yangi ta'rifdan emas, bitta qatorni qayta qilishdan boshlanadi. Uch kundan keyin to'g'ri qayta qilingan xato faol ro'yxatdan chiqishi mumkin. Faqat qarab qo'yilgan xato qoladi.

Tuzoqlar qayta ishlatiladi: noto'g'ri ot, qisqartirilmagan kasr, tengsizlikda ishora ag'darilishi, omil o'rniga hadlarni o'chirish, eski o'rniga yangining foizi. Xato daftari tuzoqni nomli dushmanga aylantiradi.
Har bir qatorda sana, mavzu, nima qilganingiz, to'g'ri g'oya va qayta sinov sanasi bo'lishi kerak. Qayta sinov sanasisiz daftar — kundalik, asbob emas.
Keyingi darsni yangi ma'ruza bilan emas, bitta daftar qatori bilan boshlang. Imtihon yaqinida tuzatish qamrovdan ustun.

examples.promptEn: A student says 20% of 50 is 50/20 = 2.5. What is the correct value?
examples.promptUz: O'quvchi 50 ning 20 foizi 50/20 = 2.5 deydi. To'g'ri qiymat necha?

steps.en: Percent of a number multiplies. 20% = 1/5.
steps.uz: Sonning foizi ko'paytiradi. 20% = 1/5.

steps.en: One fifth of 50 is (1/5) × 50 = 10.
steps.uz: 50 ning beshdan biri (1/5) × 50 = 10.

steps.en: The correct value is 10. Dividing by the percent answered a different question.
steps.uz: To'g'ri qiymat 10. Foizga bo'lish boshqa savolga javob bergan.

examples.promptEn: A price goes from 50 to 80. By what percent did it increase? A student divides 30 by 80 and gets 37.5%. What is the correct percent?
examples.promptUz: Narx 50 dan 80 ga o'tadi. U necha foizga oshdi? O'quvchi 30 ni 80 ga bo'lib 37.5% oladi. To'g'ri foiz necha?

steps.en: The change is 80 − 50 = 30. The original is 50.
steps.uz: O'zgarish 80 − 50 = 30. Eski son 50.

steps.en: Percent increase = 30/50 = 3/5 = 60%.
B divides by the new price. A is the raw change, not a percent of the original. The correct percent is 60.
steps.uz: B yangi narxga bo'ladi. A — foiz emas, xom o'zgarish. To'g'ri foiz 60.

mistakes.en: Writing the trap in the log without the correction. 'I divided by 80' is half a row. The other half is 'the original is the denominator, so 30/50 = 60%.'
mistakes.uz: Tuzatishsiz tuzoqni daftarga yozish. 'Men 80 ga bo'ldim' — qatorning yarmi. Ikkinchi yarmi — 'maxraj eski son, demak 30/50 = 60%.'

mistakes.en: Collecting ten mistakes and redoing none. One redone row teaches more than a full page of admired errors. Start the next class from the log.
mistakes.uz: O'nta xato yig'ib, birortasini qayta qilmaslik. Bitta qayta qilingan qator qarab qo'yilgan xatolar sahifasidan ko'ra ko'proq o'rgatadi. Keyingi darsni daftardan boshlang.

mistakes.en: Calling every arithmetic slip a new topic. A flipped inequality, a diameter used as a radius, and a percent of the new amount are three named moves. They do not need three new chapters.
mistakes.uz: Har bir hisob sirpanishini yangi mavzu deyish. Almashtirilgan tengsizlik, radius o'rniga diametr va yangi miqdorning foizi — uchta nomlangan yurish. Ularga uchta yangi bob kerak emas.

mini.promptEn: What is 3/5 + 1/2?
mini.promptUz: 3/5 + 1/2 nechaga teng?

mini.promptEn: What is 25% of 64?
mini.promptUz: 64 ning 25 foizi nechaga teng?

mini.promptEn: A price increases from 80 to 100. By what percent did it increase?
mini.promptUz: Narx 80 dan 100 ga oshdi. Necha foizga oshdi?

mini.promptEn: Evaluate 2^5 × 2^(−2).
mini.promptUz: 2^5 × 2^(−2) ning qiymatini toping.

mini.promptEn: Solve 3x − 4 = 11.
mini.promptUz: 3x − 4 = 11 tenglamasini yeching.

mini.promptEn: Solve (2/3)x = 10.
mini.promptUz: (2/3)x = 10 tenglamasini yeching.

mini.promptEn: What is the slope of the line through (−1, 2) and (3, 10)?
mini.promptUz: (−1, 2) va (3, 10) nuqtalardan o'tgan chiziqning qiyaligi necha?

mini.promptEn: Solve y = x + 1 and 2x + y = 7. Give both x and y.
mini.promptUz: y = x + 1 va 2x + y = 7 sistemasini yeching. x va y ning ikkalasini yozing.

mini.promptEn: If f(x) = 4x − 3, what is f(5)?
mini.promptUz: Agar f(x) = 4x − 3 bo'lsa, f(5) nechaga teng?

mini.promptEn: What is the positive solution of x² − 16 = 0?
mini.promptUz: x² − 16 = 0 tenglamaning musbat yechimi necha?

mini.promptEn: What is the minimum value of y = (x − 3)² − 2?
mini.promptUz: y = (x − 3)² − 2 ning minimum qiymati necha?

mini.promptEn: For x ≠ 1, the expression (x² − 1)/(x − 1) equals x + 1. What is its value at x = 5?
mini.promptUz: x ≠ 1 bo'lganda (x² − 1)/(x − 1) ifodasi x + 1 ga teng. x = 5 dagi qiymati necha?

mini.promptEn: Solve √(x + 5) = 4.
mini.promptUz: √(x + 5) = 4 tenglamasini yeching.

mini.promptEn: The mean of five numbers is 10. Four of them are 6, 8, 10, and 12. What is the fifth?
mini.promptUz: Besh sonning o'rta arifmetigi 10. To'rttasi 6, 8, 10 va 12. Beshinchisi necha?

mini.promptEn: The probability of red is 2/5. What is the probability of not red?
mini.promptUz: Qizil ehtimoli 2/5. Qizil emas ehtimoli necha?

mini.promptEn: Two angles of a triangle measure 35° and 65°. What is the third?
mini.promptUz: Uchburchakning ikki burchagi 35° va 65°. Uchinchi necha gradus?

mini.promptEn: A right triangle has legs 5 and 12. What is the hypotenuse?
mini.promptUz: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari 5 va 12. Gipotenuza necha?

mini.promptEn: In that same 5-12-13 triangle, what is the sine of the angle opposite the side of length 5?
mini.promptUz: O'sha 5-12-13 uchburchakda uzunligi 5 bo'lgan tomon qarshisidagi burchakning sinusi necha?

mini.promptEn: A cylinder has radius 4 and height 3. What is its volume?
mini.promptUz: Silindrning radiusi 4 va balandligi 3. Hajmi necha?

mini.promptEn: What is the radius of the circle (x − 1)² + (y − 2)² = 9?
mini.promptUz: (x − 1)² + (y − 2)² = 9 aylanasining radiusi necha?
